<span id="lblDescription">This course in an introduction to computer architecture and organization. It will cover topics in both the physical design of the computer (organization) and the logical design of the computer (architecture). The main contents include the organization of a simple stored-program computer: CPU, busses and memory; Instruction sets, machine code, and assembly language; Conventions for assembly language generated by compilers; Floating-point number representation; Hardware organization of simple processors; Address translation and virtual memory; Very introductory examples of input/output devices, interrupt handling and multi-tasking systems.<br/>Chapter covered: Computer Evolution and Performance; A Top-Level View of Computer Function and Interconnection; Cache Memory; Internal Memory; External Memory; Input/Output; Operating System Support; Instruction Sets: Characteristics and Functions; Processor Structure and Function; Reduced Instruction Set Computers; Instruction-Level Parallelism and Superscalar Processors; Parallel Processing; Multicore Computers.</span>

                    userMessage: userInput,
                    educationLevel: 'fptu'
                },
                success: function (response) {
                    console.log('=== AI Coach Response Success ===');
                    console.log('Full Response:', response);

                    $('.ai-loading').remove();

                    if (response && typeof response === 'object') {
                        if (response.Success === true) {
                            if (response.Data && response.Data.aiResponse) {
                                console.log('AI Response:', response.Data.aiResponse);
                                addMessageToChat('ai', response.Data.aiResponse);
                            } else {
                                console.error('AI Response missing data.aiResponse');
                                addMessageToChat('ai', 'Có lỗi xảy ra: Response không có dữ liệu AI');
                            }
                        } else {
                            var errorMsg = response.Message || 'Không xác định được lỗi';
                            console.error('AI Coach Error:', errorMsg);
                            addMessageToChat('ai', 'Có lỗi xảy ra: ' + errorMsg);
                        }
                    } else {
                        console.error('Invalid response format:', response);
                        addMessageToChat('ai', 'Có lỗi xảy ra: Response không đúng định dạng');
                    }
                },
                error: function (xhr, status, error) {
                    console.log('=== AI Coach Response Error ===');
                    console.error('XHR Status:', xhr.status);
                    console.error('Error:', error);

                    $('.ai-loading').remove();
                    var errorMsg = 'Không thể kết nối với AI coach. ';
                    if (xhr.responseJSON && xhr.responseJSON.Message) {
                        errorMsg += xhr.responseJSON.Message;
                    } else if (xhr.responseText) {
                        errorMsg += 'Chi tiết: ' + xhr.responseText;
                    } else {
                        errorMsg += 'Vui lòng thử lại sau.';
                    }
                    addMessageToChat('ai', errorMsg);
                }
            });
            return false;
        }

        function addMessageToChat(sender, message, isLoading = false) {
            // Ẩn quick actions container khi bắt đầu chat
            if (sender === 'user') {
                $('.ai-quick-actions-container').hide();
            }

            const messageDiv = $('<div>').addClass(`message ${sender}-message`);
            if (isLoading) messageDiv.addClass('ai-loading');

            if (sender === 'user') {
                messageDiv.html(`
                    <div class="message-content">
                        <i class="fa fa-user"></i>
                        <span>${message}</span>
                    </div>
                `);
            } else {
                const processedMessage = processAIResponse(message);
                messageDiv.html(processedMessage);
            }

            $('#chatMessages').append(messageDiv);
            $('#chatMessages').scrollTop($('#chatMessages')[0].scrollHeight);
        }

        function clearChat() {
            $('#chatMessages').empty();
            // Hiển thị lại quick actions container
            $('.ai-quick-actions-container').show();
        }

        function processAIResponse(message) {
            const sections = splitResponseIntoSections(message);

            let html = '<div class="message-content">';
            html += '<i class="fa fa-robot"></i>';

            if (sections.mainContent) {
                html += '<div class="markdown-content">' + marked.parse(sections.mainContent) + '</div>';
            }

            if (sections.followUpQuestions && sections.followUpQuestions.length > 0) {
                html += '<div class="follow-up-section">';
                html += '<div class="follow-up-title">Câu hỏi tiếp theo:</div>';
                html += '<div class="follow-up-questions">';

                sections.followUpQuestions.forEach((question, index) => {
                    html += `<div class="follow-up-question" onclick="askAI('${question.replace(/'/g, "\\'")}')">`;
                    html += `<strong>${index + 1}.</strong> ${question}`;
                    html += '</div>';
                });

                html += '</div></div>';
            }

            if (sections.references && sections.references.length > 0) {
                html += '<div class="references-section">';
                html += '<div class="references-title">Tài liệu tham khảo:</div>';

                sections.references.forEach((ref, index) => {
                    const url = extractURL(ref);
                    if (url) {
                        html += `<a href="${url}" target="_blank" class="reference-link">`;
                        html += `<i class="fa fa-external-link"></i> ${ref.replace(/\[.*?\]\s*/, '')}`;
                        html += '</a>';
                    } else {
                        html += `<div class="reference-link">${ref}</div>`;
                    }
                });

                html += '</div>';
            }

            html += '</div>';
            return html;
        }

        function splitResponseIntoSections(message) {
            const sections = {
                mainContent: '',
                followUpQuestions: [],
                references: []
            };

            const followUpMatch = message.match(/### Follow-up Questions\s*([\s\S]*?)(?=###|References:|$)/i);
            if (followUpMatch) {
                const followUpText = followUpMatch[1].trim();
                const questions = followUpText.split(/\d+\.\s+/).filter(q => q.trim());
                sections.followUpQuestions = questions.map(q => q.trim()).filter(q => q);
            }

            const referencesMatch = message.match(/References:\s*([\s\S]*?)(?=###|$)/i);
            if (referencesMatch) {
                const referencesText = referencesMatch[1].trim();
                const refs = referencesText.split(/\n/).filter(r => r.trim());
                sections.references = refs.map(r => r.trim()).filter(r => r);
            }

            let mainContent = message;
            if (followUpMatch) {
                mainContent = mainContent.replace(followUpMatch[0], '');
            }
            if (referencesMatch) {
                mainContent = mainContent.replace(referencesMatch[0], '');
            }

            sections.mainContent = mainContent.trim();
            return sections;
        }

        function extractURL(text) {
            const urlMatch = text.match(/https?:\/\/[^\s]+/);
            return urlMatch ? urlMatch[0] : null;
        }

        $('#aiUserInput').keypress(function (e) {
            if (e.which === 13) {
                e.preventDefault();
                sendAIMessage();
            }
        });

        $('#aiUserInput').on('input', function () {
            this.style.height = 'auto';
            this.style.height = Math.min(this.scrollHeight, 66) + 'px';
        });
    </script>

<script>
        let currentSubjectCode = 'CSI106';
        let chatHistory = [];

        // Cấu hình marked.js
        marked.setOptions({
            breaks: true,
            gfm: true
        });

        function toggleAICoach() {
            const widget = $('#aiCoachWidget');
            const toggleBtn = $('.ai-coach-toggle');
            if (widget.is(':visible')) {
                widget.hide();
                toggleBtn.removeClass('active');
            } else {
                widget.show();
                toggleBtn.addClass('active');
                // Đảm bảo quick actions hiển thị khi mở widget
                $('.ai-quick-actions-container').show();
            }
            return false;
        }

        function askAI(question) {
            sendAIMessage(question);
            return false;
        }

        function sendAIMessage(message = null) {
            const userInput = message || $('#aiUserInput').val();
            if (!userInput.trim()) {
                alert('Vui lòng nhập nội dung trước khi gửi!');
                return false;
            }

            console.log('=== AI Coach Request ===');
            console.log('Subject Code:', currentSubjectCode);
            console.log('User Message:', userInput);
            console.log('Education Level:', 'fptu');

            addMessageToChat('user', userInput);
            $('#aiUserInput').val('');
            addMessageToChat('ai', 'Đang suy nghĩ...', true);

            $.ajax({
                url: '/AICoach/Chat',
                method: 'POST',
                dataType: 'json',
                contentType: 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded; charset=UTF-8',
                data: {
                    subjectCode: currentSubjectCode,
                    userMessage: userInput,
                    educationLevel: 'fptu'
                },
                success: function (response) {
                    console.log('=== AI Coach Response Success ===');
                    console.log('Full Response:', response);

                    $('.ai-loading').remove();

                    if (response && typeof response === 'object') {
                        if (response.Success === true) {
                            if (response.Data && response.Data.aiResponse) {
                                console.log('AI Response:', response.Data.aiResponse);
                                addMessageToChat('ai', response.Data.aiResponse);
                            } else {
                                console.error('AI Response missing data.aiResponse');
                                addMessageToChat('ai', 'Có lỗi xảy ra: Response không có dữ liệu AI');
                            }
                        } else {
                            var errorMsg = response.Message || 'Không xác định được lỗi';
                            console.error('AI Coach Error:', errorMsg);
                            addMessageToChat('ai', 'Có lỗi xảy ra: ' + errorMsg);
                        }
                    } else {
                        console.error('Invalid response format:', response);
                        addMessageToChat('ai', 'Có lỗi xảy ra: Response không đúng định dạng');
                    }
                },
                error: function (xhr, status, error) {
                    console.log('=== AI Coach Response Error ===');
                    console.error('XHR Status:', xhr.status);
                    console.error('Error:', error);

                    $('.ai-loading').remove();
                    var errorMsg = 'Không thể kết nối với AI coach. ';
                    if (xhr.responseJSON && xhr.responseJSON.Message) {
                        errorMsg += xhr.responseJSON.Message;
                    } else if (xhr.responseText) {
                        errorMsg += 'Chi tiết: ' + xhr.responseText;
                    } else {
                        errorMsg += 'Vui lòng thử lại sau.';
                    }
                    addMessageToChat('ai', errorMsg);
                }
            });
            return false;
        }

        function addMessageToChat(sender, message, isLoading = false) {
            // Ẩn quick actions container khi bắt đầu chat
            if (sender === 'user') {
                $('.ai-quick-actions-container').hide();
            }

            const messageDiv = $('<div>').addClass(`message ${sender}-message`);
            if (isLoading) messageDiv.addClass('ai-loading');

            if (sender === 'user') {
                messageDiv.html(`
                    <div class="message-content">
                        <i class="fa fa-user"></i>
                        <span>${message}</span>
                    </div>
                `);
            } else {
                const processedMessage = processAIResponse(message);
                messageDiv.html(processedMessage);
            }

            $('#chatMessages').append(messageDiv);
            $('#chatMessages').scrollTop($('#chatMessages')[0].scrollHeight);
        }

        function clearChat() {
            $('#chatMessages').empty();
            // Hiển thị lại quick actions container
            $('.ai-quick-actions-container').show();
        }

        function processAIResponse(message) {
            const sections = splitResponseIntoSections(message);

            let html = '<div class="message-content">';
            html += '<i class="fa fa-robot"></i>';

            if (sections.mainContent) {
                html += '<div class="markdown-content">' + marked.parse(sections.mainContent) + '</div>';
            }

            if (sections.followUpQuestions && sections.followUpQuestions.length > 0) {
                html += '<div class="follow-up-section">';
                html += '<div class="follow-up-title">Câu hỏi tiếp theo:</div>';
                html += '<div class="follow-up-questions">';

                sections.followUpQuestions.forEach((question, index) => {
                    html += `<div class="follow-up-question" onclick="askAI('${question.replace(/'/g, "\\'")}')">`;
                    html += `<strong>${index + 1}.</strong> ${question}`;
                    html += '</div>';
                });

                html += '</div></div>';
            }

            if (sections.references && sections.references.length > 0) {
                html += '<div class="references-section">';
                html += '<div class="references-title">Tài liệu tham khảo:</div>';

                sections.references.forEach((ref, index) => {
                    const url = extractURL(ref);
                    if (url) {
                        html += `<a href="${url}" target="_blank" class="reference-link">`;
                        html += `<i class="fa fa-external-link"></i> ${ref.replace(/\[.*?\]\s*/, '')}`;
                        html += '</a>';
                    } else {
                        html += `<div class="reference-link">${ref}</div>`;
                    }
                });

                html += '</div>';
            }

            html += '</div>';
            return html;
        }

        function splitResponseIntoSections(message) {
            const sections = {
                mainContent: '',
                followUpQuestions: [],
                references: []
            };

            const followUpMatch = message.match(/### Follow-up Questions\s*([\s\S]*?)(?=###|References:|$)/i);
            if (followUpMatch) {
                const followUpText = followUpMatch[1].trim();
                const questions = followUpText.split(/\d+\.\s+/).filter(q => q.trim());
                sections.followUpQuestions = questions.map(q => q.trim()).filter(q => q);
            }

            const referencesMatch = message.match(/References:\s*([\s\S]*?)(?=###|$)/i);
            if (referencesMatch) {
                const referencesText = referencesMatch[1].trim();
                const refs = referencesText.split(/\n/).filter(r => r.trim());
                sections.references = refs.map(r => r.trim()).filter(r => r);
            }

            let mainContent = message;
            if (followUpMatch) {
                mainContent = mainContent.replace(followUpMatch[0], '');
            }
            if (referencesMatch) {
                mainContent = mainContent.replace(referencesMatch[0], '');
            }

            sections.mainContent = mainContent.trim();
            return sections;
        }

        function extractURL(text) {
            const urlMatch = text.match(/https?:\/\/[^\s]+/);
            return urlMatch ? urlMatch[0] : null;
        }

        $('#aiUserInput').keypress(function (e) {
            if (e.which === 13) {
                e.preventDefault();
                sendAIMessage();
            }
        });

        $('#aiUserInput').on('input', function () {
            this.style.height = 'auto';
            this.style.height = Math.min(this.scrollHeight, 66) + 'px';
        });
    </script>

<script>
        let currentSubjectCode = 'PRF192';
        let chatHistory = [];

        // Cấu hình marked.js
        marked.setOptions({
            breaks: true,
            gfm: true
        });

        function toggleAICoach() {
            const widget = $('#aiCoachWidget');
            const toggleBtn = $('.ai-coach-toggle');
            if (widget.is(':visible')) {
                widget.hide();
                toggleBtn.removeClass('active');
            } else {
                widget.show();
                toggleBtn.addClass('active');
                // Đảm bảo quick actions hiển thị khi mở widget
                $('.ai-quick-actions-container').show();
            }
            return false;
        }

        function askAI(question) {
            sendAIMessage(question);
            return false;
        }

        function sendAIMessage(message = null) {
            const userInput = message || $('#aiUserInput').val();
            if (!userInput.trim()) {
                alert('Vui lòng nhập nội dung trước khi gửi!');
                return false;
            }

            console.log('=== AI Coach Request ===');
            console.log('Subject Code:', currentSubjectCode);
            console.log('User Message:', userInput);
            console.log('Education Level:', 'fptu');

            addMessageToChat('user', userInput);
            $('#aiUserInput').val('');
            addMessageToChat('ai', 'Đang suy nghĩ...', true);

            $.ajax({
                url: '/AICoach/Chat',
                method: 'POST',
                dataType: 'json',
                contentType: 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded; charset=UTF-8',
                data: {
                    subjectCode: currentSubjectCode,
                    userMessage: userInput,
                    educationLevel: 'fptu'
                },
                success: function (response) {
                    console.log('=== AI Coach Response Success ===');
                    console.log('Full Response:', response);

                    $('.ai-loading').remove();

                    if (response && typeof response === 'object') {
                        if (response.Success === true) {
                            if (response.Data && response.Data.aiResponse) {
                                console.log('AI Response:', response.Data.aiResponse);
                                addMessageToChat('ai', response.Data.aiResponse);
                            } else {
                                console.error('AI Response missing data.aiResponse');
                                addMessageToChat('ai', 'Có lỗi xảy ra: Response không có dữ liệu AI');
                            }
                        } else {
                            var errorMsg = response.Message || 'Không xác định được lỗi';
                            console.error('AI Coach Error:', errorMsg);
                            addMessageToChat('ai', 'Có lỗi xảy ra: ' + errorMsg);
                        }
                    } else {
                        console.error('Invalid response format:', response);
                        addMessageToChat('ai', 'Có lỗi xảy ra: Response không đúng định dạng');
                    }
                },
                error: function (xhr, status, error) {
                    console.log('=== AI Coach Response Error ===');
                    console.error('XHR Status:', xhr.status);
                    console.error('Error:', error);

                    $('.ai-loading').remove();
                    var errorMsg = 'Không thể kết nối với AI coach. ';
                    if (xhr.responseJSON && xhr.responseJSON.Message) {
                        errorMsg += xhr.responseJSON.Message;
                    } else if (xhr.responseText) {
                        errorMsg += 'Chi tiết: ' + xhr.responseText;
                    } else {
                        errorMsg += 'Vui lòng thử lại sau.';
                    }
                    addMessageToChat('ai', errorMsg);
                }
            });
            return false;
        }

        function addMessageToChat(sender, message, isLoading = false) {
            // Ẩn quick actions container khi bắt đầu chat
            if (sender === 'user') {
                $('.ai-quick-actions-container').hide();
            }

            const messageDiv = $('<div>').addClass(`message ${sender}-message`);
            if (isLoading) messageDiv.addClass('ai-loading');

            if (sender === 'user') {
                messageDiv.html(`
                    <div class="message-content">
                        <i class="fa fa-user"></i>
                        <span>${message}</span>
                    </div>
                `);
            } else {
                const processedMessage = processAIResponse(message);
                messageDiv.html(processedMessage);
            }

            $('#chatMessages').append(messageDiv);
            $('#chatMessages').scrollTop($('#chatMessages')[0].scrollHeight);
        }

        function clearChat() {
            $('#chatMessages').empty();
            // Hiển thị lại quick actions container
            $('.ai-quick-actions-container').show();
        }

        function processAIResponse(message) {
            const sections = splitResponseIntoSections(message);

            let html = '<div class="message-content">';
            html += '<i class="fa fa-robot"></i>';

            if (sections.mainContent) {
                html += '<div class="markdown-content">' + marked.parse(sections.mainContent) + '</div>';
            }

            if (sections.followUpQuestions && sections.followUpQuestions.length > 0) {
                html += '<div class="follow-up-section">';
                html += '<div class="follow-up-title">Câu hỏi tiếp theo:</div>';
                html += '<div class="follow-up-questions">';

                sections.followUpQuestions.forEach((question, index) => {
                    html += `<div class="follow-up-question" onclick="askAI('${question.replace(/'/g, "\\'")}')">`;
                    html += `<strong>${index + 1}.</strong> ${question}`;
                    html += '</div>';
                });

                html += '</div></div>';
            }

            if (sections.references && sections.references.length > 0) {
                html += '<div class="references-section">';
                html += '<div class="references-title">Tài liệu tham khảo:</div>';

                sections.references.forEach((ref, index) => {
                    const url = extractURL(ref);
                    if (url) {
                        html += `<a href="${url}" target="_blank" class="reference-link">`;
                        html += `<i class="fa fa-external-link"></i> ${ref.replace(/\[.*?\]\s*/, '')}`;
                        html += '</a>';
                    } else {
                        html += `<div class="reference-link">${ref}</div>`;
                    }
                });

                html += '</div>';
            }

            html += '</div>';
            return html;
        }

        function splitResponseIntoSections(message) {
            const sections = {
                mainContent: '',
                followUpQuestions: [],
                references: []
            };

            const followUpMatch = message.match(/### Follow-up Questions\s*([\s\S]*?)(?=###|References:|$)/i);
            if (followUpMatch) {
                const followUpText = followUpMatch[1].trim();
                const questions = followUpText.split(/\d+\.\s+/).filter(q => q.trim());
                sections.followUpQuestions = questions.map(q => q.trim()).filter(q => q);
            }

            const referencesMatch = message.match(/References:\s*([\s\S]*?)(?=###|$)/i);
            if (referencesMatch) {
                const referencesText = referencesMatch[1].trim();
                const refs = referencesText.split(/\n/).filter(r => r.trim());
                sections.references = refs.map(r => r.trim()).filter(r => r);
            }

            let mainContent = message;
            if (followUpMatch) {
                mainContent = mainContent.replace(followUpMatch[0], '');
            }
            if (referencesMatch) {
                mainContent = mainContent.replace(referencesMatch[0], '');
            }

            sections.mainContent = mainContent.trim();
            return sections;
        }

        function extractURL(text) {
            const urlMatch = text.match(/https?:\/\/[^\s]+/);
            return urlMatch ? urlMatch[0] : null;
        }

        $('#aiUserInput').keypress(function (e) {
            if (e.which === 13) {
                e.preventDefault();
                sendAIMessage();
            }
        });

        $('#aiUserInput').on('input', function () {
            this.style.height = 'auto';
            this.style.height = Math.min(this.scrollHeight, 66) + 'px';
        });
    </script>

<div>
<table border="1" cellspacing="0" class="table table-striped" id="gvLO" rules="all" style="border-collapse:collapse;">
<tr>
<th scope="col">CLO Name</th><th scope="col">CLO Details</th><th scope="col">LO Details</th>
</tr><tr>
<td align="center" style="width:5%;">
                        1
                    </td><td style="width:20%;">CLO1</td><td style="width:80%;">Describe basic properties and find the limit of a function
LO1.1	Find the domain, range, zeros and analyze the symmetry of the graph; create new functions from old functions.
LO1.2	Find the slope and write an equation of a line; describe how a function changes under graph translations.
LO1.3	Compute the limit of a function using graphs and limit laws, including the Squeeze's Theorem.
LO1.4	Find limits at infinity and infinity limits, and apply in finding asymptotes of a function.
LO1.5	Identify where a function is continuous; use the Intermedia Value Theorem to show that an equation has a solution.</td>
</tr><tr>
<td align="center" style="width:5%;">
                        2
                    </td><td style="width:20%;">CLO2</td><td style="width:80%;">Calculate derivatives of a function
LO2.1	Find the average rate of change; identify derivative as the limit of a difference quotient. 
LO2.2	Recognize derivative as the instantaneous velocity and the slope of tangent lines.
LO2.3	Find derivatives using basic formulas and the sum, difference, product, quotient, chain rules. </td>
</tr><tr>
<td align="center" style="width:5%;">
                        3
                    </td><td style="width:20%;">CLO3</td><td style="width:80%;">Use derivatives to analyze a function and to solve applications
LO3.1	Use implicit differentiation to find derivatives and to solve related rates problems.
LO3.2	Find linear approximation of a function; calculate differentials and apply in calculating errors of approximation.
LO3.3	Apply Rolle's Theorem and Mean Value Theorem to a function; find critical numbers and absolute extrema of a function. 
LO3.4	Identify local extrema, and describe the monotonicity of a function; solve optimization problems.
LO3.5	Recognize acceleration as second derivative; determine inflection points and describe the concavity of a function.
LO3.6	Use Newton method to approximate solutions of an equation.</td>
</tr><tr>
<td align="center" style="width:5%;">
                        4
                    </td><td style="width:20%;">CLO4</td><td style="width:80%;">Calculate integrals and find area under the graph of a function
LO4.1	Use Riemann sums to approximate area; recognize area as a definite integral which is the limit of Riemann sums.
LO4.2	Apply the Fundamental Theorems of Calculus to find derivatives of integrals, and to evaluate definite integrals. 
LO4.3	Recognize indefinite integrals as anti-derivatives; find integrals using basic formulas and the techniques of substitution and integration by parts.
LO4.4	Use integration to solve applications and to compute the average value of a function. 
LO4.5	Approximate definite integrals using Midpoint, Trapezoidal and Simpson rules. 
LO4.6	Determine if an improper integral converges. </td>
</tr><tr>
<td align="center" style="width:5%;">
                        5
                    </td><td style="width:20%;">CLO5</td><td style="width:80%;">Solve a system of linear equations using Gaussian elimination
LO5.1	Identify if a matrix is in echelon forms; carry a matrix into an echelon using row operations; calculate the rank of a matrix. 
LO5.2	Use echelon matrices to solve/describe the solution set of a linear system.</td>
</tr><tr>
<td align="center" style="width:5%;">
                        6
                    </td><td style="width:20%;">CLO6</td><td style="width:80%;">Perform basic operations on matrices and manipulate matrix transformations
LO6.1	Perform addition, scalar multiplication and transpose of matrices; verify if a matrix is symmetric.
LO6.2	Multiply two matrices of appropriate sizes; transform between a linear system and a matrix equation.
LO6.3	Determine the matrix of a linear transformation; use properties of linear transformations in solving problems.</td>
</tr><tr>
<td align="center" style="width:5%;">
                        7
                    </td><td style="width:20%;">CLO7</td><td style="width:80%;">Find the determinant, inverse and diagonalization of a matrix
LO7.1	Compute the cofactors and the determinant of a matrix; analyze determinants in relation with row/column operations.
LO7.2	Check if a matrix is invertible; find the adjugate and the inverse of a matrix; use properties of inverses and determinants in solving problems.
LO7.3	Solve a system of linear equations using inverse matrices or Cramer's rule.
LO7.4	Find the characteristic polynomial, eigenvalues and eigenvectors to diagonalize a matrix; check if a matrix is diagonalizable.</td>
</tr><tr>
<td align="center" style="width:5%;">
                        8
                    </td><td style="width:20%;">CLO8</td><td style="width:80%;">Manipulate vector operations and linear transformations in R^3.
LO8.1	Manipulate vector operations; find equations of lines. 
LO8.2	Compute the dot product and the angle between two vectors; find the projection of a vector on another vector and manipulate equations of planes.
LO8.3	Compute the cross product; analyze areas and volumns in relation with dot and cross products.
LO8.4	Determine linear transformations in R^3 and discuss applications in computer graphic.</td>
</tr><tr>
<td align="center" style="width:5%;">
                        9
                    </td><td style="width:20%;">CLO9</td><td style="width:80%;">Find the dimension and bases of a subspace
LO9.1	Determine if a subset of vectors is a subspace; describe the subspace spanned by a set of vectors.
LO9.2	Check if a set of vectors are independent; determine if a set of vectors form a basis.
LO9.3	Find a basis and the dimension of a subspace; analyze the rank in relation with the dimension of the column, row and the null space of a matrix.
LO9.4	Compute dot product and length of vectors; check if a set of vectors are orthogonal or orthonormal; write a vector as a linear combination of an orthogonal basis.</td>
</tr>
</table>

<script>
        let currentSubjectCode = 'MAE101';
        let chatHistory = [];

        // Cấu hình marked.js
        marked.setOptions({
            breaks: true,
            gfm: true
        });

        function toggleAICoach() {
            const widget = $('#aiCoachWidget');
            const toggleBtn = $('.ai-coach-toggle');
            if (widget.is(':visible')) {
                widget.hide();
                toggleBtn.removeClass('active');
            } else {
                widget.show();
                toggleBtn.addClass('active');
                // Đảm bảo quick actions hiển thị khi mở widget
                $('.ai-quick-actions-container').show();
            }
            return false;
        }

        function askAI(question) {
            sendAIMessage(question);
            return false;
        }

        function sendAIMessage(message = null) {
            const userInput = message || $('#aiUserInput').val();
            if (!userInput.trim()) {
                alert('Vui lòng nhập nội dung trước khi gửi!');
                return false;
            }

            console.log('=== AI Coach Request ===');
            console.log('Subject Code:', currentSubjectCode);
            console.log('User Message:', userInput);
            console.log('Education Level:', 'fptu');

            addMessageToChat('user', userInput);
            $('#aiUserInput').val('');
            addMessageToChat('ai', 'Đang suy nghĩ...', true);

            $.ajax({
                url: '/AICoach/Chat',
                method: 'POST',
                dataType: 'json',
                contentType: 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded; charset=UTF-8',
                data: {
                    subjectCode: currentSubjectCode,
                    userMessage: userInput,
                    educationLevel: 'fptu'
                },
                success: function (response) {
                    console.log('=== AI Coach Response Success ===');
                    console.log('Full Response:', response);

                    $('.ai-loading').remove();

                    if (response && typeof response === 'object') {
                        if (response.Success === true) {
                            if (response.Data && response.Data.aiResponse) {
                                console.log('AI Response:', response.Data.aiResponse);
                                addMessageToChat('ai', response.Data.aiResponse);
                            } else {
                                console.error('AI Response missing data.aiResponse');
                                addMessageToChat('ai', 'Có lỗi xảy ra: Response không có dữ liệu AI');
                            }
                        } else {
                            var errorMsg = response.Message || 'Không xác định được lỗi';
                            console.error('AI Coach Error:', errorMsg);
                            addMessageToChat('ai', 'Có lỗi xảy ra: ' + errorMsg);
                        }
                    } else {
                        console.error('Invalid response format:', response);
                        addMessageToChat('ai', 'Có lỗi xảy ra: Response không đúng định dạng');
                    }
                },
                error: function (xhr, status, error) {
                    console.log('=== AI Coach Response Error ===');
                    console.error('XHR Status:', xhr.status);
                    console.error('Error:', error);

                    $('.ai-loading').remove();
                    var errorMsg = 'Không thể kết nối với AI coach. ';
                    if (xhr.responseJSON && xhr.responseJSON.Message) {
                        errorMsg += xhr.responseJSON.Message;
                    } else if (xhr.responseText) {
                        errorMsg += 'Chi tiết: ' + xhr.responseText;
                    } else {
                        errorMsg += 'Vui lòng thử lại sau.';
                    }
                    addMessageToChat('ai', errorMsg);
                }
            });
            return false;
        }

        function addMessageToChat(sender, message, isLoading = false) {
            // Ẩn quick actions container khi bắt đầu chat
            if (sender === 'user') {
                $('.ai-quick-actions-container').hide();
            }

            const messageDiv = $('<div>').addClass(`message ${sender}-message`);
            if (isLoading) messageDiv.addClass('ai-loading');

            if (sender === 'user') {
                messageDiv.html(`
                    <div class="message-content">
                        <i class="fa fa-user"></i>
                        <span>${message}</span>
                    </div>
                `);
            } else {
                const processedMessage = processAIResponse(message);
                messageDiv.html(processedMessage);
            }

            $('#chatMessages').append(messageDiv);
            $('#chatMessages').scrollTop($('#chatMessages')[0].scrollHeight);
        }

        function clearChat() {
            $('#chatMessages').empty();
            // Hiển thị lại quick actions container
            $('.ai-quick-actions-container').show();
        }

        function processAIResponse(message) {
            const sections = splitResponseIntoSections(message);

            let html = '<div class="message-content">';
            html += '<i class="fa fa-robot"></i>';

            if (sections.mainContent) {
                html += '<div class="markdown-content">' + marked.parse(sections.mainContent) + '</div>';
            }

            if (sections.followUpQuestions && sections.followUpQuestions.length > 0) {
                html += '<div class="follow-up-section">';
                html += '<div class="follow-up-title">Câu hỏi tiếp theo:</div>';
                html += '<div class="follow-up-questions">';

                sections.followUpQuestions.forEach((question, index) => {
                    html += `<div class="follow-up-question" onclick="askAI('${question.replace(/'/g, "\\'")}')">`;
                    html += `<strong>${index + 1}.</strong> ${question}`;
                    html += '</div>';
                });

                html += '</div></div>';
            }

            if (sections.references && sections.references.length > 0) {
                html += '<div class="references-section">';
                html += '<div class="references-title">Tài liệu tham khảo:</div>';

                sections.references.forEach((ref, index) => {
                    const url = extractURL(ref);
                    if (url) {
                        html += `<a href="${url}" target="_blank" class="reference-link">`;
                        html += `<i class="fa fa-external-link"></i> ${ref.replace(/\[.*?\]\s*/, '')}`;
                        html += '</a>';
                    } else {
                        html += `<div class="reference-link">${ref}</div>`;
                    }
                });

                html += '</div>';
            }

            html += '</div>';
            return html;
        }

        function splitResponseIntoSections(message) {
            const sections = {
                mainContent: '',
                followUpQuestions: [],
                references: []
            };

            const followUpMatch = message.match(/### Follow-up Questions\s*([\s\S]*?)(?=###|References:|$)/i);
            if (followUpMatch) {
                const followUpText = followUpMatch[1].trim();
                const questions = followUpText.split(/\d+\.\s+/).filter(q => q.trim());
                sections.followUpQuestions = questions.map(q => q.trim()).filter(q => q);
            }

            const referencesMatch = message.match(/References:\s*([\s\S]*?)(?=###|$)/i);
            if (referencesMatch) {
                const referencesText = referencesMatch[1].trim();
                const refs = referencesText.split(/\n/).filter(r => r.trim());
                sections.references = refs.map(r => r.trim()).filter(r => r);
            }

            let mainContent = message;
            if (followUpMatch) {
                mainContent = mainContent.replace(followUpMatch[0], '');
            }
            if (referencesMatch) {
                mainContent = mainContent.replace(referencesMatch[0], '');
            }

            sections.mainContent = mainContent.trim();
            return sections;
        }

        function extractURL(text) {
            const urlMatch = text.match(/https?:\/\/[^\s]+/);
            return urlMatch ? urlMatch[0] : null;
        }

        $('#aiUserInput').keypress(function (e) {
            if (e.which === 13) {
                e.preventDefault();
                sendAIMessage();
            }
        });

        $('#aiUserInput').on('input', function () {
            this.style.height = 'auto';
            this.style.height = Math.min(this.scrollHeight, 66) + 'px';
        });
    </script>

<script>
        let currentSubjectCode = 'MAD101';
        let chatHistory = [];

        // Cấu hình marked.js
        marked.setOptions({
            breaks: true,
            gfm: true
        });

        function toggleAICoach() {
            const widget = $('#aiCoachWidget');
            const toggleBtn = $('.ai-coach-toggle');
            if (widget.is(':visible')) {
                widget.hide();
                toggleBtn.removeClass('active');
            } else {
                widget.show();
                toggleBtn.addClass('active');
                // Đảm bảo quick actions hiển thị khi mở widget
                $('.ai-quick-actions-container').show();
            }
            return false;
        }

        function askAI(question) {
            sendAIMessage(question);
            return false;
        }

        function sendAIMessage(message = null) {
            const userInput = message || $('#aiUserInput').val();
            if (!userInput.trim()) {
                alert('Vui lòng nhập nội dung trước khi gửi!');
                return false;
            }

            console.log('=== AI Coach Request ===');
            console.log('Subject Code:', currentSubjectCode);
            console.log('User Message:', userInput);
            console.log('Education Level:', 'fptu');

            addMessageToChat('user', userInput);
            $('#aiUserInput').val('');
            addMessageToChat('ai', 'Đang suy nghĩ...', true);

            $.ajax({
                url: '/AICoach/Chat',
                method: 'POST',
                dataType: 'json',
                contentType: 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded; charset=UTF-8',
                data: {
                    subjectCode: currentSubjectCode,
                    userMessage: userInput,
                    educationLevel: 'fptu'
                },
                success: function (response) {
                    console.log('=== AI Coach Response Success ===');
                    console.log('Full Response:', response);

                    $('.ai-loading').remove();

                    if (response && typeof response === 'object') {
                        if (response.Success === true) {
                            if (response.Data && response.Data.aiResponse) {
                                console.log('AI Response:', response.Data.aiResponse);
                                addMessageToChat('ai', response.Data.aiResponse);
                            } else {
                                console.error('AI Response missing data.aiResponse');
                                addMessageToChat('ai', 'Có lỗi xảy ra: Response không có dữ liệu AI');
                            }
                        } else {
                            var errorMsg = response.Message || 'Không xác định được lỗi';
                            console.error('AI Coach Error:', errorMsg);
                            addMessageToChat('ai', 'Có lỗi xảy ra: ' + errorMsg);
                        }
                    } else {
                        console.error('Invalid response format:', response);
                        addMessageToChat('ai', 'Có lỗi xảy ra: Response không đúng định dạng');
                    }
                },
                error: function (xhr, status, error) {
                    console.log('=== AI Coach Response Error ===');
                    console.error('XHR Status:', xhr.status);
                    console.error('Error:', error);

                    $('.ai-loading').remove();
                    var errorMsg = 'Không thể kết nối với AI coach. ';
                    if (xhr.responseJSON && xhr.responseJSON.Message) {
                        errorMsg += xhr.responseJSON.Message;
                    } else if (xhr.responseText) {
                        errorMsg += 'Chi tiết: ' + xhr.responseText;
                    } else {
                        errorMsg += 'Vui lòng thử lại sau.';
                    }
                    addMessageToChat('ai', errorMsg);
                }
            });
            return false;
        }

        function addMessageToChat(sender, message, isLoading = false) {
            // Ẩn quick actions container khi bắt đầu chat
            if (sender === 'user') {
                $('.ai-quick-actions-container').hide();
            }

            const messageDiv = $('<div>').addClass(`message ${sender}-message`);
            if (isLoading) messageDiv.addClass('ai-loading');

            if (sender === 'user') {
                messageDiv.html(`
                    <div class="message-content">
                        <i class="fa fa-user"></i>
                        <span>${message}</span>
                    </div>
                `);
            } else {
                const processedMessage = processAIResponse(message);
                messageDiv.html(processedMessage);
            }

            $('#chatMessages').append(messageDiv);
            $('#chatMessages').scrollTop($('#chatMessages')[0].scrollHeight);
        }

        function clearChat() {
            $('#chatMessages').empty();
            // Hiển thị lại quick actions container
            $('.ai-quick-actions-container').show();
        }

        function processAIResponse(message) {
            const sections = splitResponseIntoSections(message);

            let html = '<div class="message-content">';
            html += '<i class="fa fa-robot"></i>';

            if (sections.mainContent) {
                html += '<div class="markdown-content">' + marked.parse(sections.mainContent) + '</div>';
            }

            if (sections.followUpQuestions && sections.followUpQuestions.length > 0) {
                html += '<div class="follow-up-section">';
                html += '<div class="follow-up-title">Câu hỏi tiếp theo:</div>';
                html += '<div class="follow-up-questions">';

                sections.followUpQuestions.forEach((question, index) => {
                    html += `<div class="follow-up-question" onclick="askAI('${question.replace(/'/g, "\\'")}')">`;
                    html += `<strong>${index + 1}.</strong> ${question}`;
                    html += '</div>';
                });

                html += '</div></div>';
            }

            if (sections.references && sections.references.length > 0) {
                html += '<div class="references-section">';
                html += '<div class="references-title">Tài liệu tham khảo:</div>';

                sections.references.forEach((ref, index) => {
                    const url = extractURL(ref);
                    if (url) {
                        html += `<a href="${url}" target="_blank" class="reference-link">`;
                        html += `<i class="fa fa-external-link"></i> ${ref.replace(/\[.*?\]\s*/, '')}`;
                        html += '</a>';
                    } else {
                        html += `<div class="reference-link">${ref}</div>`;
                    }
                });

                html += '</div>';
            }

            html += '</div>';
            return html;
        }

        function splitResponseIntoSections(message) {
            const sections = {
                mainContent: '',
                followUpQuestions: [],
                references: []
            };

            const followUpMatch = message.match(/### Follow-up Questions\s*([\s\S]*?)(?=###|References:|$)/i);
            if (followUpMatch) {
                const followUpText = followUpMatch[1].trim();
                const questions = followUpText.split(/\d+\.\s+/).filter(q => q.trim());
                sections.followUpQuestions = questions.map(q => q.trim()).filter(q => q);
            }

            const referencesMatch = message.match(/References:\s*([\s\S]*?)(?=###|$)/i);
            if (referencesMatch) {
                const referencesText = referencesMatch[1].trim();
                const refs = referencesText.split(/\n/).filter(r => r.trim());
                sections.references = refs.map(r => r.trim()).filter(r => r);
            }

            let mainContent = message;
            if (followUpMatch) {
                mainContent = mainContent.replace(followUpMatch[0], '');
            }
            if (referencesMatch) {
                mainContent = mainContent.replace(referencesMatch[0], '');
            }

            sections.mainContent = mainContent.trim();
            return sections;
        }

        function extractURL(text) {
            const urlMatch = text.match(/https?:\/\/[^\s]+/);
            return urlMatch ? urlMatch[0] : null;
        }

        $('#aiUserInput').keypress(function (e) {
            if (e.which === 13) {
                e.preventDefault();
                sendAIMessage();
            }
        });

        $('#aiUserInput').on('input', function () {
            this.style.height = 'auto';
            this.style.height = Math.min(this.scrollHeight, 66) + 'px';
        });
    </script>

<script>
        let currentSubjectCode = 'NWC204';
        let chatHistory = [];

        // Cấu hình marked.js
        marked.setOptions({
            breaks: true,
            gfm: true
        });

        function toggleAICoach() {
            const widget = $('#aiCoachWidget');
            const toggleBtn = $('.ai-coach-toggle');
            if (widget.is(':visible')) {
                widget.hide();
                toggleBtn.removeClass('active');
            } else {
                widget.show();
                toggleBtn.addClass('active');
                // Đảm bảo quick actions hiển thị khi mở widget
                $('.ai-quick-actions-container').show();
            }
            return false;
        }

        function askAI(question) {
            sendAIMessage(question);
            return false;
        }

        function sendAIMessage(message = null) {
            const userInput = message || $('#aiUserInput').val();
            if (!userInput.trim()) {
                alert('Vui lòng nhập nội dung trước khi gửi!');
                return false;
            }

            console.log('=== AI Coach Request ===');
            console.log('Subject Code:', currentSubjectCode);
            console.log('User Message:', userInput);
            console.log('Education Level:', 'fptu');

            addMessageToChat('user', userInput);
            $('#aiUserInput').val('');
            addMessageToChat('ai', 'Đang suy nghĩ...', true);

            $.ajax({
                url: '/AICoach/Chat',
                method: 'POST',
                dataType: 'json',
                contentType: 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded; charset=UTF-8',
                data: {
                    subjectCode: currentSubjectCode,
                    userMessage: userInput,
                    educationLevel: 'fptu'
                },
                success: function (response) {
                    console.log('=== AI Coach Response Success ===');
                    console.log('Full Response:', response);

                    $('.ai-loading').remove();

                    if (response && typeof response === 'object') {
                        if (response.Success === true) {
                            if (response.Data && response.Data.aiResponse) {
                                console.log('AI Response:', response.Data.aiResponse);
                                addMessageToChat('ai', response.Data.aiResponse);
                            } else {
                                console.error('AI Response missing data.aiResponse');
                                addMessageToChat('ai', 'Có lỗi xảy ra: Response không có dữ liệu AI');
                            }
                        } else {
                            var errorMsg = response.Message || 'Không xác định được lỗi';
                            console.error('AI Coach Error:', errorMsg);
                            addMessageToChat('ai', 'Có lỗi xảy ra: ' + errorMsg);
                        }
                    } else {
                        console.error('Invalid response format:', response);
                        addMessageToChat('ai', 'Có lỗi xảy ra: Response không đúng định dạng');
                    }
                },
                error: function (xhr, status, error) {
                    console.log('=== AI Coach Response Error ===');
                    console.error('XHR Status:', xhr.status);
                    console.error('Error:', error);

                    $('.ai-loading').remove();
                    var errorMsg = 'Không thể kết nối với AI coach. ';
                    if (xhr.responseJSON && xhr.responseJSON.Message) {
                        errorMsg += xhr.responseJSON.Message;
                    } else if (xhr.responseText) {
                        errorMsg += 'Chi tiết: ' + xhr.responseText;
                    } else {
                        errorMsg += 'Vui lòng thử lại sau.';
                    }
                    addMessageToChat('ai', errorMsg);
                }
            });
            return false;
        }

        function addMessageToChat(sender, message, isLoading = false) {
            // Ẩn quick actions container khi bắt đầu chat
            if (sender === 'user') {
                $('.ai-quick-actions-container').hide();
            }

            const messageDiv = $('<div>').addClass(`message ${sender}-message`);
            if (isLoading) messageDiv.addClass('ai-loading');

            if (sender === 'user') {
                messageDiv.html(`
                    <div class="message-content">
                        <i class="fa fa-user"></i>
                        <span>${message}</span>
                    </div>
                `);
            } else {
                const processedMessage = processAIResponse(message);
                messageDiv.html(processedMessage);
            }

            $('#chatMessages').append(messageDiv);
            $('#chatMessages').scrollTop($('#chatMessages')[0].scrollHeight);
        }

        function clearChat() {
            $('#chatMessages').empty();
            // Hiển thị lại quick actions container
            $('.ai-quick-actions-container').show();
        }

        function processAIResponse(message) {
            const sections = splitResponseIntoSections(message);

            let html = '<div class="message-content">';
            html += '<i class="fa fa-robot"></i>';

            if (sections.mainContent) {
                html += '<div class="markdown-content">' + marked.parse(sections.mainContent) + '</div>';
            }

            if (sections.followUpQuestions && sections.followUpQuestions.length > 0) {
                html += '<div class="follow-up-section">';
                html += '<div class="follow-up-title">Câu hỏi tiếp theo:</div>';
                html += '<div class="follow-up-questions">';

                sections.followUpQuestions.forEach((question, index) => {
                    html += `<div class="follow-up-question" onclick="askAI('${question.replace(/'/g, "\\'")}')">`;
                    html += `<strong>${index + 1}.</strong> ${question}`;
                    html += '</div>';
                });

                html += '</div></div>';
            }

            if (sections.references && sections.references.length > 0) {
                html += '<div class="references-section">';
                html += '<div class="references-title">Tài liệu tham khảo:</div>';

                sections.references.forEach((ref, index) => {
                    const url = extractURL(ref);
                    if (url) {
                        html += `<a href="${url}" target="_blank" class="reference-link">`;
                        html += `<i class="fa fa-external-link"></i> ${ref.replace(/\[.*?\]\s*/, '')}`;
                        html += '</a>';
                    } else {
                        html += `<div class="reference-link">${ref}</div>`;
                    }
                });

                html += '</div>';
            }

            html += '</div>';
            return html;
        }

        function splitResponseIntoSections(message) {
            const sections = {
                mainContent: '',
                followUpQuestions: [],
                references: []
            };

            const followUpMatch = message.match(/### Follow-up Questions\s*([\s\S]*?)(?=###|References:|$)/i);
            if (followUpMatch) {
                const followUpText = followUpMatch[1].trim();
                const questions = followUpText.split(/\d+\.\s+/).filter(q => q.trim());
                sections.followUpQuestions = questions.map(q => q.trim()).filter(q => q);
            }

            const referencesMatch = message.match(/References:\s*([\s\S]*?)(?=###|$)/i);
            if (referencesMatch) {
                const referencesText = referencesMatch[1].trim();
                const refs = referencesText.split(/\n/).filter(r => r.trim());
                sections.references = refs.map(r => r.trim()).filter(r => r);
            }

            let mainContent = message;
            if (followUpMatch) {
                mainContent = mainContent.replace(followUpMatch[0], '');
            }

<script>
        let currentSubjectCode = 'OSG202';
        let chatHistory = [];

        // Cấu hình marked.js
        marked.setOptions({
            breaks: true,
            gfm: true
        });

        function toggleAICoach() {
            const widget = $('#aiCoachWidget');
            const toggleBtn = $('.ai-coach-toggle');
            if (widget.is(':visible')) {
                widget.hide();
                toggleBtn.removeClass('active');
            } else {
                widget.show();
                toggleBtn.addClass('active');
                // Đảm bảo quick actions hiển thị khi mở widget
                $('.ai-quick-actions-container').show();
            }
            return false;
        }

        function askAI(question) {
            sendAIMessage(question);
            return false;
        }

        function sendAIMessage(message = null) {
            const userInput = message || $('#aiUserInput').val();
            if (!userInput.trim()) {
                alert('Vui lòng nhập nội dung trước khi gửi!');
                return false;
            }

            console.log('=== AI Coach Request ===');
            console.log('Subject Code:', currentSubjectCode);
            console.log('User Message:', userInput);
            console.log('Education Level:', 'fptu');

            addMessageToChat('user', userInput);
            $('#aiUserInput').val('');
            addMessageToChat('ai', 'Đang suy nghĩ...', true);

            $.ajax({
                url: '/AICoach/Chat',
                method: 'POST',
                dataType: 'json',
                contentType: 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded; charset=UTF-8',
                data: {
                    subjectCode: currentSubjectCode,
                    userMessage: userInput,
                    educationLevel: 'fptu'
                },
                success: function (response) {
                    console.log('=== AI Coach Response Success ===');
                    console.log('Full Response:', response);

                    $('.ai-loading').remove();

                    if (response && typeof response === 'object') {
                        if (response.Success === true) {
                            if (response.Data && response.Data.aiResponse) {
                                console.log('AI Response:', response.Data.aiResponse);
                                addMessageToChat('ai', response.Data.aiResponse);
                            } else {
                                console.error('AI Response missing data.aiResponse');
                                addMessageToChat('ai', 'Có lỗi xảy ra: Response không có dữ liệu AI');
                            }
                        } else {
                            var errorMsg = response.Message || 'Không xác định được lỗi';
                            console.error('AI Coach Error:', errorMsg);
                            addMessageToChat('ai', 'Có lỗi xảy ra: ' + errorMsg);
                        }
                    } else {
                        console.error('Invalid response format:', response);
                        addMessageToChat('ai', 'Có lỗi xảy ra: Response không đúng định dạng');
                    }
                },
                error: function (xhr, status, error) {
                    console.log('=== AI Coach Response Error ===');
                    console.error('XHR Status:', xhr.status);
                    console.error('Error:', error);

                    $('.ai-loading').remove();
                    var errorMsg = 'Không thể kết nối với AI coach. ';
                    if (xhr.responseJSON && xhr.responseJSON.Message) {
                        errorMsg += xhr.responseJSON.Message;
                    } else if (xhr.responseText) {
                        errorMsg += 'Chi tiết: ' + xhr.responseText;
                    } else {
                        errorMsg += 'Vui lòng thử lại sau.';
                    }
                    addMessageToChat('ai', errorMsg);
                }
            });
            return false;
        }

        function addMessageToChat(sender, message, isLoading = false) {
            // Ẩn quick actions container khi bắt đầu chat
            if (sender === 'user') {
                $('.ai-quick-actions-container').hide();
            }

            const messageDiv = $('<div>').addClass(`message ${sender}-message`);
            if (isLoading) messageDiv.addClass('ai-loading');

            if (sender === 'user') {
                messageDiv.html(`
                    <div class="message-content">
                        <i class="fa fa-user"></i>
                        <span>${message}</span>
                    </div>
                `);
            } else {
                const processedMessage = processAIResponse(message);
                messageDiv.html(processedMessage);
            }

            $('#chatMessages').append(messageDiv);
            $('#chatMessages').scrollTop($('#chatMessages')[0].scrollHeight);
        }

        function clearChat() {
            $('#chatMessages').empty();
            // Hiển thị lại quick actions container
            $('.ai-quick-actions-container').show();
        }

        function processAIResponse(message) {
            const sections = splitResponseIntoSections(message);

            let html = '<div class="message-content">';
            html += '<i class="fa fa-robot"></i>';

            if (sections.mainContent) {
                html += '<div class="markdown-content">' + marked.parse(sections.mainContent) + '</div>';
            }

            if (sections.followUpQuestions && sections.followUpQuestions.length > 0) {
                html += '<div class="follow-up-section">';
                html += '<div class="follow-up-title">Câu hỏi tiếp theo:</div>';
                html += '<div class="follow-up-questions">';

                sections.followUpQuestions.forEach((question, index) => {
                    html += `<div class="follow-up-question" onclick="askAI('${question.replace(/'/g, "\\'")}')">`;
                    html += `<strong>${index + 1}.</strong> ${question}`;
                    html += '</div>';
                });

                html += '</div></div>';
            }

            if (sections.references && sections.references.length > 0) {
                html += '<div class="references-section">';
                html += '<div class="references-title">Tài liệu tham khảo:</div>';

                sections.references.forEach((ref, index) => {
                    const url = extractURL(ref);
                    if (url) {
                        html += `<a href="${url}" target="_blank" class="reference-link">`;
                        html += `<i class="fa fa-external-link"></i> ${ref.replace(/\[.*?\]\s*/, '')}`;
                        html += '</a>';
                    } else {
                        html += `<div class="reference-link">${ref}</div>`;
                    }
                });

                html += '</div>';
            }

            html += '</div>';
            return html;
        }

        function splitResponseIntoSections(message) {
            const sections = {
                mainContent: '',
                followUpQuestions: [],
                references: []
            };

            const followUpMatch = message.match(/### Follow-up Questions\s*([\s\S]*?)(?=###|References:|$)/i);
            if (followUpMatch) {
                const followUpText = followUpMatch[1].trim();
                const questions = followUpText.split(/\d+\.\s+/).filter(q => q.trim());
                sections.followUpQuestions = questions.map(q => q.trim()).filter(q => q);
            }

            const referencesMatch = message.match(/References:\s*([\s\S]*?)(?=###|$)/i);
            if (referencesMatch) {
                const referencesText = referencesMatch[1].trim();
                const refs = referencesText.split(/\n/).filter(r => r.trim());
                sections.references = refs.map(r => r.trim()).filter(r => r);
            }

            let mainContent = message;
            if (followUpMatch) {
                mainContent = mainContent.replace(followUpMatch[0], '');
            }
            if (referencesMatch) {
                mainContent = mainContent.replace(referencesMatch[0], '');
            }

            sections.mainContent = mainContent.trim();
            return sections;
        }

        function extractURL(text) {
            const urlMatch = text.match(/https?:\/\/[^\s]+/);
            return urlMatch ? urlMatch[0] : null;
        }

        $('#aiUserInput').keypress(function (e) {
            if (e.which === 13) {
                e.preventDefault();
                sendAIMessage();
            }
        });

        $('#aiUserInput').on('input', function () {
            this.style.height = 'auto';
            this.style.height = Math.min(this.scrollHeight, 66) + 'px';
        });
    </script>

<script>
        let currentSubjectCode = 'PRO192';
        let chatHistory = [];

        // Cấu hình marked.js
        marked.setOptions({
            breaks: true,
            gfm: true
        });

        function toggleAICoach() {
            const widget = $('#aiCoachWidget');
            const toggleBtn = $('.ai-coach-toggle');
            if (widget.is(':visible')) {
                widget.hide();
                toggleBtn.removeClass('active');
            } else {
                widget.show();
                toggleBtn.addClass('active');
                // Đảm bảo quick actions hiển thị khi mở widget
                $('.ai-quick-actions-container').show();
            }
            return false;
        }

        function askAI(question) {
            sendAIMessage(question);
            return false;
        }

        function sendAIMessage(message = null) {
            const userInput = message || $('#aiUserInput').val();
            if (!userInput.trim()) {
                alert('Vui lòng nhập nội dung trước khi gửi!');
                return false;
            }

            console.log('=== AI Coach Request ===');
            console.log('Subject Code:', currentSubjectCode);
            console.log('User Message:', userInput);
            console.log('Education Level:', 'fptu');

            addMessageToChat('user', userInput);
            $('#aiUserInput').val('');
            addMessageToChat('ai', 'Đang suy nghĩ...', true);

            $.ajax({
                url: '/AICoach/Chat',
                method: 'POST',
                dataType: 'json',
                contentType: 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded; charset=UTF-8',
                data: {
                    subjectCode: currentSubjectCode,
                    userMessage: userInput,
                    educationLevel: 'fptu'
                },
                success: function (response) {
                    console.log('=== AI Coach Response Success ===');
                    console.log('Full Response:', response);

                    $('.ai-loading').remove();

                    if (response && typeof response === 'object') {
                        if (response.Success === true) {
                            if (response.Data && response.Data.aiResponse) {
                                console.log('AI Response:', response.Data.aiResponse);
                                addMessageToChat('ai', response.Data.aiResponse);
                            } else {
                                console.error('AI Response missing data.aiResponse');
                                addMessageToChat('ai', 'Có lỗi xảy ra: Response không có dữ liệu AI');
                            }
                        } else {
                            var errorMsg = response.Message || 'Không xác định được lỗi';
                            console.error('AI Coach Error:', errorMsg);
                            addMessageToChat('ai', 'Có lỗi xảy ra: ' + errorMsg);
                        }
                    } else {
                        console.error('Invalid response format:', response);
                        addMessageToChat('ai', 'Có lỗi xảy ra: Response không đúng định dạng');
                    }
                },
                error: function (xhr, status, error) {
                    console.log('=== AI Coach Response Error ===');
                    console.error('XHR Status:', xhr.status);
                    console.error('Error:', error);

                    $('.ai-loading').remove();
                    var errorMsg = 'Không thể kết nối với AI coach. ';
                    if (xhr.responseJSON && xhr.responseJSON.Message) {
                        errorMsg += xhr.responseJSON.Message;
                    } else if (xhr.responseText) {
                        errorMsg += 'Chi tiết: ' + xhr.responseText;
                    } else {
                        errorMsg += 'Vui lòng thử lại sau.';
                    }
                    addMessageToChat('ai', errorMsg);
                }
            });
            return false;
        }

        function addMessageToChat(sender, message, isLoading = false) {
            // Ẩn quick actions container khi bắt đầu chat
            if (sender === 'user') {
                $('.ai-quick-actions-container').hide();
            }

            const messageDiv = $('<div>').addClass(`message ${sender}-message`);
            if (isLoading) messageDiv.addClass('ai-loading');

            if (sender === 'user') {
                messageDiv.html(`
                    <div class="message-content">
                        <i class="fa fa-user"></i>
                        <span>${message}</span>
                    </div>
                `);
            } else {
                const processedMessage = processAIResponse(message);
                messageDiv.html(processedMessage);
            }

            $('#chatMessages').append(messageDiv);
            $('#chatMessages').scrollTop($('#chatMessages')[0].scrollHeight);
        }

        function clearChat() {
            $('#chatMessages').empty();
            // Hiển thị lại quick actions container
            $('.ai-quick-actions-container').show();
        }

        function processAIResponse(message) {
            const sections = splitResponseIntoSections(message);

            let html = '<div class="message-content">';
            html += '<i class="fa fa-robot"></i>';

            if (sections.mainContent) {
                html += '<div class="markdown-content">' + marked.parse(sections.mainContent) + '</div>';
            }

            if (sections.followUpQuestions && sections.followUpQuestions.length > 0) {
                html += '<div class="follow-up-section">';
                html += '<div class="follow-up-title">Câu hỏi tiếp theo:</div>';
                html += '<div class="follow-up-questions">';

                sections.followUpQuestions.forEach((question, index) => {
                    html += `<div class="follow-up-question" onclick="askAI('${question.replace(/'/g, "\\'")}')">`;
                    html += `<strong>${index + 1}.</strong> ${question}`;
                    html += '</div>';
                });

                html += '</div></div>';
            }

            if (sections.references && sections.references.length > 0) {
                html += '<div class="references-section">';
                html += '<div class="references-title">Tài liệu tham khảo:</div>';

                sections.references.forEach((ref, index) => {
                    const url = extractURL(ref);
                    if (url) {
                        html += `<a href="${url}" target="_blank" class="reference-link">`;
                        html += `<i class="fa fa-external-link"></i> ${ref.replace(/\[.*?\]\s*/, '')}`;
                        html += '</a>';
                    } else {
                        html += `<div class="reference-link">${ref}</div>`;
                    }
                });

                html += '</div>';
            }

            html += '</div>';
            return html;
        }

        function splitResponseIntoSections(message) {
            const sections = {
                mainContent: '',
                followUpQuestions: [],
                references: []
            };

            const followUpMatch = message.match(/### Follow-up Questions\s*([\s\S]*?)(?=###|References:|$)/i);
            if (followUpMatch) {
                const followUpText = followUpMatch[1].trim();
                const questions = followUpText.split(/\d+\.\s+/).filter(q => q.trim());
                sections.followUpQuestions = questions.map(q => q.trim()).filter(q => q);
            }

            const referencesMatch = message.match(/References:\s*([\s\S]*?)(?=###|$)/i);
            if (referencesMatch) {
                const referencesText = referencesMatch[1].trim();
                const refs = referencesText.split(/\n/).filter(r => r.trim());
                sections.references = refs.map(r => r.trim()).filter(r => r);
            }

            let mainContent = message;
            if (followUpMatch) {
                mainContent = mainContent.replace(followUpMatch[0], '');
            }
            if (referencesMatch) {
                mainContent = mainContent.replace(referencesMatch[0], '');
            }

            sections.mainContent = mainContent.trim();
            return sections;
        }

        function extractURL(text) {
            const urlMatch = text.match(/https?:\/\/[^\s]+/);
            return urlMatch ? urlMatch[0] : null;
        }

        $('#aiUserInput').keypress(function (e) {
            if (e.which === 13) {
                e.preventDefault();
                sendAIMessage();
            }
        });

        $('#aiUserInput').on('input', function () {
            this.style.height = 'auto';
            this.style.height = Math.min(this.scrollHeight, 66) + 'px';
        });
    </script>

                "onclick": null,

                "hideDuration": "1000",

                "extendedTimeOut": "1000",
                "showEasing": "swing",
                "hideEasing": "linear",

                "hideMethod": "fadeOut"

            if (window.localStorage.getItem('typeToast') == 1) {

            if (window.localStorage.getItem('typeToast') == 2) {

                window.localStorage.setItem('typeToast', 0);
            }
        });

            window.localStorage.setItem('typeToast', type);
            window.localStorage.setItem('messToast', mess);
        }

        @keyframes spin {
            to {
                transform: rotate(360deg);
            }
