<script>
        let currentSubjectCode = 'WED201c';
        let chatHistory = [];

        // Cấu hình marked.js
        marked.setOptions({
            breaks: true,
            gfm: true
        });

        function toggleAICoach() {
            const widget = $('#aiCoachWidget');
            const toggleBtn = $('.ai-coach-toggle');
            if (widget.is(':visible')) {
                widget.hide();
                toggleBtn.removeClass('active');
            } else {
                widget.show();
                toggleBtn.addClass('active');
                // Đảm bảo quick actions hiển thị khi mở widget
                $('.ai-quick-actions-container').show();
            }
            return false;
        }

        function askAI(question) {
            sendAIMessage(question);
            return false;
        }

        function sendAIMessage(message = null) {
            const userInput = message || $('#aiUserInput').val();
            if (!userInput.trim()) {
                alert('Vui lòng nhập nội dung trước khi gửi!');
                return false;
            }

            console.log('=== AI Coach Request ===');
            console.log('Subject Code:', currentSubjectCode);
            console.log('User Message:', userInput);
            console.log('Education Level:', 'fptu');

            addMessageToChat('user', userInput);
            $('#aiUserInput').val('');
            addMessageToChat('ai', 'Đang suy nghĩ...', true);

            $.ajax({
                url: '/AICoach/Chat',
                method: 'POST',
                dataType: 'json',
                contentType: 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded; charset=UTF-8',
                data: {
                    subjectCode: currentSubjectCode,
                    userMessage: userInput,
                    educationLevel: 'fptu'
                },
                success: function (response) {
                    console.log('=== AI Coach Response Success ===');
                    console.log('Full Response:', response);

                    $('.ai-loading').remove();

                    if (response && typeof response === 'object') {
                        if (response.Success === true) {
                            if (response.Data && response.Data.aiResponse) {
                                console.log('AI Response:', response.Data.aiResponse);
                                addMessageToChat('ai', response.Data.aiResponse);
                            } else {
                                console.error('AI Response missing data.aiResponse');
                                addMessageToChat('ai', 'Có lỗi xảy ra: Response không có dữ liệu AI');
                            }
                        } else {
                            var errorMsg = response.Message || 'Không xác định được lỗi';
                            console.error('AI Coach Error:', errorMsg);
                            addMessageToChat('ai', 'Có lỗi xảy ra: ' + errorMsg);
                        }
                    } else {
                        console.error('Invalid response format:', response);
                        addMessageToChat('ai', 'Có lỗi xảy ra: Response không đúng định dạng');
                    }
                },
                error: function (xhr, status, error) {
                    console.log('=== AI Coach Response Error ===');
                    console.error('XHR Status:', xhr.status);
                    console.error('Error:', error);

                    $('.ai-loading').remove();
                    var errorMsg = 'Không thể kết nối với AI coach. ';
                    if (xhr.responseJSON && xhr.responseJSON.Message) {
                        errorMsg += xhr.responseJSON.Message;
                    } else if (xhr.responseText) {
                        errorMsg += 'Chi tiết: ' + xhr.responseText;
                    } else {
                        errorMsg += 'Vui lòng thử lại sau.';
                    }
                    addMessageToChat('ai', errorMsg);
                }
            });
            return false;
        }

        function addMessageToChat(sender, message, isLoading = false) {
            // Ẩn quick actions container khi bắt đầu chat
            if (sender === 'user') {
                $('.ai-quick-actions-container').hide();
            }

            const messageDiv = $('<div>').addClass(`message ${sender}-message`);
            if (isLoading) messageDiv.addClass('ai-loading');

            if (sender === 'user') {
                messageDiv.html(`
                    <div class="message-content">
                        <i class="fa fa-user"></i>
                        <span>${message}</span>
                    </div>
                `);
            } else {
                const processedMessage = processAIResponse(message);
                messageDiv.html(processedMessage);
            }

            $('#chatMessages').append(messageDiv);
            $('#chatMessages').scrollTop($('#chatMessages')[0].scrollHeight);
        }

        function clearChat() {
            $('#chatMessages').empty();
            // Hiển thị lại quick actions container
            $('.ai-quick-actions-container').show();
        }

        function processAIResponse(message) {
            const sections = splitResponseIntoSections(message);

            let html = '<div class="message-content">';
            html += '<i class="fa fa-robot"></i>';

            if (sections.mainContent) {
                html += '<div class="markdown-content">' + marked.parse(sections.mainContent) + '</div>';
            }

            if (sections.followUpQuestions && sections.followUpQuestions.length > 0) {
                html += '<div class="follow-up-section">';
                html += '<div class="follow-up-title">Câu hỏi tiếp theo:</div>';
                html += '<div class="follow-up-questions">';

                sections.followUpQuestions.forEach((question, index) => {
                    html += `<div class="follow-up-question" onclick="askAI('${question.replace(/'/g, "\\'")}')">`;
                    html += `<strong>${index + 1}.</strong> ${question}`;
                    html += '</div>';
                });

                html += '</div></div>';
            }

            if (sections.references && sections.references.length > 0) {
                html += '<div class="references-section">';
                html += '<div class="references-title">Tài liệu tham khảo:</div>';

                sections.references.forEach((ref, index) => {
                    const url = extractURL(ref);
                    if (url) {
                        html += `<a href="${url}" target="_blank" class="reference-link">`;
                        html += `<i class="fa fa-external-link"></i> ${ref.replace(/\[.*?\]\s*/, '')}`;
                        html += '</a>';
                    } else {
                        html += `<div class="reference-link">${ref}</div>`;
                    }
                });

                html += '</div>';
            }

            html += '</div>';
            return html;
        }

        function splitResponseIntoSections(message) {
            const sections = {
                mainContent: '',
                followUpQuestions: [],
                references: []
            };

            const followUpMatch = message.match(/### Follow-up Questions\s*([\s\S]*?)(?=###|References:|$)/i);
            if (followUpMatch) {
                const followUpText = followUpMatch[1].trim();
                const questions = followUpText.split(/\d+\.\s+/).filter(q => q.trim());
                sections.followUpQuestions = questions.map(q => q.trim()).filter(q => q);
            }

            const referencesMatch = message.match(/References:\s*([\s\S]*?)(?=###|$)/i);
            if (referencesMatch) {
                const referencesText = referencesMatch[1].trim();
                const refs = referencesText.split(/\n/).filter(r => r.trim());
                sections.references = refs.map(r => r.trim()).filter(r => r);
            }

            let mainContent = message;
            if (followUpMatch) {
                mainContent = mainContent.replace(followUpMatch[0], '');
            }
            if (referencesMatch) {
                mainContent = mainContent.replace(referencesMatch[0], '');
            }

            sections.mainContent = mainContent.trim();
            return sections;
        }

        function extractURL(text) {
            const urlMatch = text.match(/https?:\/\/[^\s]+/);
            return urlMatch ? urlMatch[0] : null;
        }

        $('#aiUserInput').keypress(function (e) {
            if (e.which === 13) {
                e.preventDefault();
                sendAIMessage();
            }
        });

        $('#aiUserInput').on('input', function () {
            this.style.height = 'auto';
            this.style.height = Math.min(this.scrollHeight, 66) + 'px';
        });
    </script>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</form>

<script>
        let currentSubjectCode = 'DBI202';
        let chatHistory = [];

        // Cấu hình marked.js
        marked.setOptions({
            breaks: true,
            gfm: true
        });

        function toggleAICoach() {
            const widget = $('#aiCoachWidget');
            const toggleBtn = $('.ai-coach-toggle');
            if (widget.is(':visible')) {
                widget.hide();
                toggleBtn.removeClass('active');
            } else {
                widget.show();
                toggleBtn.addClass('active');
                // Đảm bảo quick actions hiển thị khi mở widget
                $('.ai-quick-actions-container').show();
            }
            return false;
        }

        function askAI(question) {
            sendAIMessage(question);
            return false;
        }

        function sendAIMessage(message = null) {
            const userInput = message || $('#aiUserInput').val();
            if (!userInput.trim()) {
                alert('Vui lòng nhập nội dung trước khi gửi!');
                return false;
            }

            console.log('=== AI Coach Request ===');
            console.log('Subject Code:', currentSubjectCode);
            console.log('User Message:', userInput);
            console.log('Education Level:', 'fptu');

            addMessageToChat('user', userInput);
            $('#aiUserInput').val('');
            addMessageToChat('ai', 'Đang suy nghĩ...', true);

            $.ajax({
                url: '/AICoach/Chat',
                method: 'POST',
                dataType: 'json',
                contentType: 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded; charset=UTF-8',
                data: {
                    subjectCode: currentSubjectCode,
                    userMessage: userInput,
                    educationLevel: 'fptu'
                },
                success: function (response) {
                    console.log('=== AI Coach Response Success ===');
                    console.log('Full Response:', response);

                    $('.ai-loading').remove();

                    if (response && typeof response === 'object') {
                        if (response.Success === true) {
                            if (response.Data && response.Data.aiResponse) {
                                console.log('AI Response:', response.Data.aiResponse);
                                addMessageToChat('ai', response.Data.aiResponse);
                            } else {
                                console.error('AI Response missing data.aiResponse');
                                addMessageToChat('ai', 'Có lỗi xảy ra: Response không có dữ liệu AI');
                            }
                        } else {
                            var errorMsg = response.Message || 'Không xác định được lỗi';
                            console.error('AI Coach Error:', errorMsg);
                            addMessageToChat('ai', 'Có lỗi xảy ra: ' + errorMsg);
                        }
                    } else {
                        console.error('Invalid response format:', response);
                        addMessageToChat('ai', 'Có lỗi xảy ra: Response không đúng định dạng');
                    }
                },
                error: function (xhr, status, error) {
                    console.log('=== AI Coach Response Error ===');
                    console.error('XHR Status:', xhr.status);
                    console.error('Error:', error);

                    $('.ai-loading').remove();
                    var errorMsg = 'Không thể kết nối với AI coach. ';
                    if (xhr.responseJSON && xhr.responseJSON.Message) {
                        errorMsg += xhr.responseJSON.Message;
                    } else if (xhr.responseText) {
                        errorMsg += 'Chi tiết: ' + xhr.responseText;
                    } else {
                        errorMsg += 'Vui lòng thử lại sau.';
                    }
                    addMessageToChat('ai', errorMsg);
                }
            });
            return false;
        }

        function addMessageToChat(sender, message, isLoading = false) {
            // Ẩn quick actions container khi bắt đầu chat
            if (sender === 'user') {
                $('.ai-quick-actions-container').hide();
            }

            const messageDiv = $('<div>').addClass(`message ${sender}-message`);
            if (isLoading) messageDiv.addClass('ai-loading');

            if (sender === 'user') {
                messageDiv.html(`
                    <div class="message-content">
                        <i class="fa fa-user"></i>
                        <span>${message}</span>
                    </div>
                `);
            } else {
                const processedMessage = processAIResponse(message);
                messageDiv.html(processedMessage);
            }

            $('#chatMessages').append(messageDiv);
            $('#chatMessages').scrollTop($('#chatMessages')[0].scrollHeight);
        }

        function clearChat() {
            $('#chatMessages').empty();
            // Hiển thị lại quick actions container
            $('.ai-quick-actions-container').show();
        }

        function processAIResponse(message) {
            const sections = splitResponseIntoSections(message);

            let html = '<div class="message-content">';
            html += '<i class="fa fa-robot"></i>';

            if (sections.mainContent) {
                html += '<div class="markdown-content">' + marked.parse(sections.mainContent) + '</div>';
            }

            if (sections.followUpQuestions && sections.followUpQuestions.length > 0) {
                html += '<div class="follow-up-section">';
                html += '<div class="follow-up-title">Câu hỏi tiếp theo:</div>';
                html += '<div class="follow-up-questions">';

                sections.followUpQuestions.forEach((question, index) => {
                    html += `<div class="follow-up-question" onclick="askAI('${question.replace(/'/g, "\\'")}')">`;
                    html += `<strong>${index + 1}.</strong> ${question}`;
                    html += '</div>';
                });

                html += '</div></div>';
            }

            if (sections.references && sections.references.length > 0) {
                html += '<div class="references-section">';
                html += '<div class="references-title">Tài liệu tham khảo:</div>';

                sections.references.forEach((ref, index) => {
                    const url = extractURL(ref);
                    if (url) {
                        html += `<a href="${url}" target="_blank" class="reference-link">`;
                        html += `<i class="fa fa-external-link"></i> ${ref.replace(/\[.*?\]\s*/, '')}`;
                        html += '</a>';
                    } else {
                        html += `<div class="reference-link">${ref}</div>`;
                    }
                });

                html += '</div>';
            }

            html += '</div>';
            return html;
        }

        function splitResponseIntoSections(message) {
            const sections = {
                mainContent: '',
                followUpQuestions: [],
                references: []
            };

            const followUpMatch = message.match(/### Follow-up Questions\s*([\s\S]*?)(?=###|References:|$)/i);
            if (followUpMatch) {
                const followUpText = followUpMatch[1].trim();
                const questions = followUpText.split(/\d+\.\s+/).filter(q => q.trim());
                sections.followUpQuestions = questions.map(q => q.trim()).filter(q => q);
            }

            const referencesMatch = message.match(/References:\s*([\s\S]*?)(?=###|$)/i);
            if (referencesMatch) {
                const referencesText = referencesMatch[1].trim();
                const refs = referencesText.split(/\n/).filter(r => r.trim());
                sections.references = refs.map(r => r.trim()).filter(r => r);
            }

            let mainContent = message;
            if (followUpMatch) {
                mainContent = mainContent.replace(followUpMatch[0], '');
            }
            if (referencesMatch) {
                mainContent = mainContent.replace(referencesMatch[0], '');
            }

            sections.mainContent = mainContent.trim();
            return sections;
        }

        function extractURL(text) {
            const urlMatch = text.match(/https?:\/\/[^\s]+/);
            return urlMatch ? urlMatch[0] : null;
        }

        $('#aiUserInput').keypress(function (e) {
            if (e.which === 13) {
                e.preventDefault();
                sendAIMessage();
            }
        });

        $('#aiUserInput').on('input', function () {
            this.style.height = 'auto';
            this.style.height = Math.min(this.scrollHeight, 66) + 'px';
        });
    </script>

            }

        @keyframes spin {
            to {
                transform: rotate(360deg);
            }

<script>
        let currentSubjectCode = 'LAB211';
        let chatHistory = [];

        // Cấu hình marked.js
        marked.setOptions({
            breaks: true,
            gfm: true
        });

        function toggleAICoach() {
            const widget = $('#aiCoachWidget');
            const toggleBtn = $('.ai-coach-toggle');
            if (widget.is(':visible')) {
                widget.hide();
                toggleBtn.removeClass('active');
            } else {
                widget.show();
                toggleBtn.addClass('active');
                // Đảm bảo quick actions hiển thị khi mở widget
                $('.ai-quick-actions-container').show();
            }
            return false;
        }

        function askAI(question) {
            sendAIMessage(question);
            return false;
        }

        function sendAIMessage(message = null) {
            const userInput = message || $('#aiUserInput').val();
            if (!userInput.trim()) {
                alert('Vui lòng nhập nội dung trước khi gửi!');
                return false;
            }

            console.log('=== AI Coach Request ===');
            console.log('Subject Code:', currentSubjectCode);
            console.log('User Message:', userInput);
            console.log('Education Level:', 'fptu');

            addMessageToChat('user', userInput);
            $('#aiUserInput').val('');
            addMessageToChat('ai', 'Đang suy nghĩ...', true);

            $.ajax({
                url: '/AICoach/Chat',
                method: 'POST',
                dataType: 'json',
                contentType: 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded; charset=UTF-8',
                data: {
                    subjectCode: currentSubjectCode,
                    userMessage: userInput,
                    educationLevel: 'fptu'
                },
                success: function (response) {
                    console.log('=== AI Coach Response Success ===');
                    console.log('Full Response:', response);

                    $('.ai-loading').remove();

                    if (response && typeof response === 'object') {
                        if (response.Success === true) {
                            if (response.Data && response.Data.aiResponse) {
                                console.log('AI Response:', response.Data.aiResponse);
                                addMessageToChat('ai', response.Data.aiResponse);
                            } else {
                                console.error('AI Response missing data.aiResponse');
                                addMessageToChat('ai', 'Có lỗi xảy ra: Response không có dữ liệu AI');
                            }
                        } else {
                            var errorMsg = response.Message || 'Không xác định được lỗi';
                            console.error('AI Coach Error:', errorMsg);
                            addMessageToChat('ai', 'Có lỗi xảy ra: ' + errorMsg);
                        }
                    } else {
                        console.error('Invalid response format:', response);
                        addMessageToChat('ai', 'Có lỗi xảy ra: Response không đúng định dạng');
                    }
                },
                error: function (xhr, status, error) {
                    console.log('=== AI Coach Response Error ===');
                    console.error('XHR Status:', xhr.status);
                    console.error('Error:', error);

                    $('.ai-loading').remove();
                    var errorMsg = 'Không thể kết nối với AI coach. ';
                    if (xhr.responseJSON && xhr.responseJSON.Message) {
                        errorMsg += xhr.responseJSON.Message;
                    } else if (xhr.responseText) {
                        errorMsg += 'Chi tiết: ' + xhr.responseText;
                    } else {
                        errorMsg += 'Vui lòng thử lại sau.';
                    }
                    addMessageToChat('ai', errorMsg);
                }
            });
            return false;
        }

        function addMessageToChat(sender, message, isLoading = false) {
            // Ẩn quick actions container khi bắt đầu chat
            if (sender === 'user') {
                $('.ai-quick-actions-container').hide();
            }

            const messageDiv = $('<div>').addClass(`message ${sender}-message`);
            if (isLoading) messageDiv.addClass('ai-loading');

            if (sender === 'user') {
                messageDiv.html(`
                    <div class="message-content">
                        <i class="fa fa-user"></i>
                        <span>${message}</span>
                    </div>
                `);
            } else {
                const processedMessage = processAIResponse(message);
                messageDiv.html(processedMessage);
            }

            $('#chatMessages').append(messageDiv);
            $('#chatMessages').scrollTop($('#chatMessages')[0].scrollHeight);
        }

        function clearChat() {
            $('#chatMessages').empty();
            // Hiển thị lại quick actions container
            $('.ai-quick-actions-container').show();
        }

        function processAIResponse(message) {
            const sections = splitResponseIntoSections(message);

            let html = '<div class="message-content">';
            html += '<i class="fa fa-robot"></i>';

            if (sections.mainContent) {
                html += '<div class="markdown-content">' + marked.parse(sections.mainContent) + '</div>';
            }

            if (sections.followUpQuestions && sections.followUpQuestions.length > 0) {
                html += '<div class="follow-up-section">';
                html += '<div class="follow-up-title">Câu hỏi tiếp theo:</div>';
                html += '<div class="follow-up-questions">';

                sections.followUpQuestions.forEach((question, index) => {
                    html += `<div class="follow-up-question" onclick="askAI('${question.replace(/'/g, "\\'")}')">`;
                    html += `<strong>${index + 1}.</strong> ${question}`;
                    html += '</div>';
                });

                html += '</div></div>';
            }

            if (sections.references && sections.references.length > 0) {
                html += '<div class="references-section">';
                html += '<div class="references-title">Tài liệu tham khảo:</div>';

                sections.references.forEach((ref, index) => {
                    const url = extractURL(ref);
                    if (url) {
                        html += `<a href="${url}" target="_blank" class="reference-link">`;
                        html += `<i class="fa fa-external-link"></i> ${ref.replace(/\[.*?\]\s*/, '')}`;
                        html += '</a>';
                    } else {
                        html += `<div class="reference-link">${ref}</div>`;
                    }
                });

                html += '</div>';
            }

            html += '</div>';
            return html;
        }

        function splitResponseIntoSections(message) {
            const sections = {
                mainContent: '',
                followUpQuestions: [],
                references: []
            };

            const followUpMatch = message.match(/### Follow-up Questions\s*([\s\S]*?)(?=###|References:|$)/i);
            if (followUpMatch) {
                const followUpText = followUpMatch[1].trim();
                const questions = followUpText.split(/\d+\.\s+/).filter(q => q.trim());
                sections.followUpQuestions = questions.map(q => q.trim()).filter(q => q);
            }

            const referencesMatch = message.match(/References:\s*([\s\S]*?)(?=###|$)/i);
            if (referencesMatch) {
                const referencesText = referencesMatch[1].trim();
                const refs = referencesText.split(/\n/).filter(r => r.trim());
                sections.references = refs.map(r => r.trim()).filter(r => r);
            }

            let mainContent = message;
            if (followUpMatch) {
                mainContent = mainContent.replace(followUpMatch[0], '');
            }
            if (referencesMatch) {
                mainContent = mainContent.replace(referencesMatch[0], '');
            }

            sections.mainContent = mainContent.trim();
            return sections;
        }

        function extractURL(text) {
            const urlMatch = text.match(/https?:\/\/[^\s]+/);
            return urlMatch ? urlMatch[0] : null;
        }

        $('#aiUserInput').keypress(function (e) {
            if (e.which === 13) {
                e.preventDefault();
                sendAIMessage();
            }
        });

        $('#aiUserInput').on('input', function () {
            this.style.height = 'auto';
            this.style.height = Math.min(this.scrollHeight, 66) + 'px';
        });
    </script>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</form>

<td class="auto-style6">
<span id="lblDescription">The course includes two parts:<br/>The first part introduces the use of Generative AI (GenAI) and Large Language Models (LLMs) in modern software development. Students will learn how AI-powered tools can accelerate the software engineering process, from analyzing requirements to generating code, writing tests, debugging, and producing technical documentation.<br/>The second part provides a comprehensive introduction to modern software engineering principles, methods, and practices. The course equips students with the foundational and advanced skills needed to design, develop, test, deploy, and maintain reliable software systems. Learners explore the full software development lifecycle (SDLC), including requirements engineering, architectural and object-oriented design, software construction, quality assurance, and DevOps practices. Emphasis is placed on practical, industry-relevant techniques such as version control, automated testing, API development, and iterative development using Agile.         @keyframes spin {
            to {
                transform: rotate(360deg);
            }

<script>
        let currentSubjectCode = 'SWE202c';
        let chatHistory = [];

        // Cấu hình marked.js
        marked.setOptions({
            breaks: true,
            gfm: true
        });

        function toggleAICoach() {
            const widget = $('#aiCoachWidget');
            const toggleBtn = $('.ai-coach-toggle');
            if (widget.is(':visible')) {
                widget.hide();
                toggleBtn.removeClass('active');
            } else {
                widget.show();
                toggleBtn.addClass('active');
                // Đảm bảo quick actions hiển thị khi mở widget
                $('.ai-quick-actions-container').show();
            }
            return false;
        }

        function askAI(question) {
            sendAIMessage(question);
            return false;
        }

        function sendAIMessage(message = null) {
            const userInput = message || $('#aiUserInput').val();
            if (!userInput.trim()) {
                alert('Vui lòng nhập nội dung trước khi gửi!');
                return false;
            }

            console.log('=== AI Coach Request ===');
            console.log('Subject Code:', currentSubjectCode);
            console.log('User Message:', userInput);
            console.log('Education Level:', 'fptu');

            addMessageToChat('user', userInput);
            $('#aiUserInput').val('');
            addMessageToChat('ai', 'Đang suy nghĩ...', true);

            $.ajax({
                url: '/AICoach/Chat',
                method: 'POST',
                dataType: 'json',
                contentType: 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded; charset=UTF-8',
                data: {
                    subjectCode: currentSubjectCode,
                    userMessage: userInput,
                    educationLevel: 'fptu'
                },
                success: function (response) {
                    console.log('=== AI Coach Response Success ===');
                    console.log('Full Response:', response);

                    $('.ai-loading').remove();

                    if (response && typeof response === 'object') {
                        if (response.Success === true) {
                            if (response.Data && response.Data.aiResponse) {
                                console.log('AI Response:', response.Data.aiResponse);
                                addMessageToChat('ai', response.Data.aiResponse);
                            } else {
                                console.error('AI Response missing data.aiResponse');
                                addMessageToChat('ai', 'Có lỗi xảy ra: Response không có dữ liệu AI');
                            }
                        } else {
                            var errorMsg = response.Message || 'Không xác định được lỗi';
                            console.error('AI Coach Error:', errorMsg);
                            addMessageToChat('ai', 'Có lỗi xảy ra: ' + errorMsg);
                        }
                    } else {
                        console.error('Invalid response format:', response);
                        addMessageToChat('ai', 'Có lỗi xảy ra: Response không đúng định dạng');
                    }
                },
                error: function (xhr, status, error) {
                    console.log('=== AI Coach Response Error ===');
                    console.error('XHR Status:', xhr.status);
                    console.error('Error:', error);

                    $('.ai-loading').remove();
                    var errorMsg = 'Không thể kết nối với AI coach. ';
                    if (xhr.responseJSON && xhr.responseJSON.Message) {
                        errorMsg += xhr.responseJSON.Message;
                    } else if (xhr.responseText) {
                        errorMsg += 'Chi tiết: ' + xhr.responseText;
                    } else {
                        errorMsg += 'Vui lòng thử lại sau.';
                    }
                    addMessageToChat('ai', errorMsg);
                }
            });
            return false;
        }

        function addMessageToChat(sender, message, isLoading = false) {
            // Ẩn quick actions container khi bắt đầu chat
            if (sender === 'user') {
                $('.ai-quick-actions-container').hide();
            }

            const messageDiv = $('<div>').addClass(`message ${sender}-message`);
            if (isLoading) messageDiv.addClass('ai-loading');

            if (sender === 'user') {
                messageDiv.html(`
                    <div class="message-content">
                        <i class="fa fa-user"></i>
                        <span>${message}</span>
                    </div>
                `);
            } else {
                const processedMessage = processAIResponse(message);
                messageDiv.html(processedMessage);
            }

            $('#chatMessages').append(messageDiv);
            $('#chatMessages').scrollTop($('#chatMessages')[0].scrollHeight);
        }

        function clearChat() {
            $('#chatMessages').empty();
            // Hiển thị lại quick actions container
            $('.ai-quick-actions-container').show();
        }

        function processAIResponse(message) {
            const sections = splitResponseIntoSections(message);

            let html = '<div class="message-content">';
            html += '<i class="fa fa-robot"></i>';

            if (sections.mainContent) {
                html += '<div class="markdown-content">' + marked.parse(sections.mainContent) + '</div>';
            }

            if (sections.followUpQuestions && sections.followUpQuestions.length > 0) {
                html += '<div class="follow-up-section">';
                html += '<div class="follow-up-title">Câu hỏi tiếp theo:</div>';
                html += '<div class="follow-up-questions">';

                sections.followUpQuestions.forEach((question, index) => {
                    html += `<div class="follow-up-question" onclick="askAI('${question.replace(/'/g, "\\'")}')">`;
                    html += `<strong>${index + 1}.</strong> ${question}`;
                    html += '</div>';
                });

                html += '</div></div>';
            }

            if (sections.references && sections.references.length > 0) {
                html += '<div class="references-section">';
                html += '<div class="references-title">Tài liệu tham khảo:</div>';

                sections.references.forEach((ref, index) => {
                    const url = extractURL(ref);
                    if (url) {
                        html += `<a href="${url}" target="_blank" class="reference-link">`;
                        html += `<i class="fa fa-external-link"></i> ${ref.replace(/\[.*?\]\s*/, '')}`;
                        html += '</a>';
                    } else {
                        html += `<div class="reference-link">${ref}</div>`;
                    }
                });

                html += '</div>';
            }

            html += '</div>';
            return html;
        }

        function splitResponseIntoSections(message) {
            const sections = {
                mainContent: '',
                followUpQuestions: [],
                references: []
            };

            const followUpMatch = message.match(/### Follow-up Questions\s*([\s\S]*?)(?=###|References:|$)/i);
            if (followUpMatch) {
                const followUpText = followUpMatch[1].trim();
                const questions = followUpText.split(/\d+\.\s+/).filter(q => q.trim());
                sections.followUpQuestions = questions.map(q => q.trim()).filter(q => q);
            }

            const referencesMatch = message.match(/References:\s*([\s\S]*?)(?=###|$)/i);
            if (referencesMatch) {
                const referencesText = referencesMatch[1].trim();
                const refs = referencesText.split(/\n/).filter(r => r.trim());
                sections.references = refs.map(r => r.trim()).filter(r => r);
            }

            let mainContent = message;
            if (followUpMatch) {
                mainContent = mainContent.replace(followUpMatch[0], '');
            }
            if (referencesMatch) {
                mainContent = mainContent.replace(referencesMatch[0], '');
            }

            sections.mainContent = mainContent.trim();
            return sections;
        }

        function extractURL(text) {
            const urlMatch = text.match(/https?:\/\/[^\s]+/);
            return urlMatch ? urlMatch[0] : null;
        }

        $('#aiUserInput').keypress(function (e) {
            if (e.which === 13) {
                e.preventDefault();
                sendAIMessage();
            }
        });

        $('#aiUserInput').on('input', function () {
            this.style.height = 'auto';
            this.style.height = Math.min(this.scrollHeight, 66) + 'px';
        });
    </script>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</form>

<script>
        let currentSubjectCode = 'IOT102';
        let chatHistory = [];

        // Cấu hình marked.js
        marked.setOptions({
            breaks: true,
            gfm: true
        });

        function toggleAICoach() {
            const widget = $('#aiCoachWidget');
            const toggleBtn = $('.ai-coach-toggle');
            if (widget.is(':visible')) {
                widget.hide();
                toggleBtn.removeClass('active');
            } else {
                widget.show();
                toggleBtn.addClass('active');
                // Đảm bảo quick actions hiển thị khi mở widget
                $('.ai-quick-actions-container').show();
            }
            return false;
        }

        function askAI(question) {
            sendAIMessage(question);
            return false;
        }

        function sendAIMessage(message = null) {
            const userInput = message || $('#aiUserInput').val();
            if (!userInput.trim()) {
                alert('Vui lòng nhập nội dung trước khi gửi!');
                return false;
            }

            console.log('=== AI Coach Request ===');
            console.log('Subject Code:', currentSubjectCode);
            console.log('User Message:', userInput);
            console.log('Education Level:', 'fptu');

            addMessageToChat('user', userInput);
            $('#aiUserInput').val('');
            addMessageToChat('ai', 'Đang suy nghĩ...', true);

            $.ajax({
                url: '/AICoach/Chat',
                method: 'POST',
                dataType: 'json',
                contentType: 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded; charset=UTF-8',
                data: {
                    subjectCode: currentSubjectCode,
                    userMessage: userInput,
                    educationLevel: 'fptu'
                },
                success: function (response) {
                    console.log('=== AI Coach Response Success ===');
                    console.log('Full Response:', response);

                    $('.ai-loading').remove();

                    if (response && typeof response === 'object') {
                        if (response.Success === true) {
                            if (response.Data && response.Data.aiResponse) {
                                console.log('AI Response:', response.Data.aiResponse);
                                addMessageToChat('ai', response.Data.aiResponse);
                            } else {
                                console.error('AI Response missing data.aiResponse');
                                addMessageToChat('ai', 'Có lỗi xảy ra: Response không có dữ liệu AI');
                            }
                        } else {
                            var errorMsg = response.Message || 'Không xác định được lỗi';
                            console.error('AI Coach Error:', errorMsg);
                            addMessageToChat('ai', 'Có lỗi xảy ra: ' + errorMsg);
                        }
                    } else {
                        console.error('Invalid response format:', response);
                        addMessageToChat('ai', 'Có lỗi xảy ra: Response không đúng định dạng');
                    }
                },
                error: function (xhr, status, error) {
                    console.log('=== AI Coach Response Error ===');
                    console.error('XHR Status:', xhr.status);
                    console.error('Error:', error);

                    $('.ai-loading').remove();
                    var errorMsg = 'Không thể kết nối với AI coach. ';
                    if (xhr.responseJSON && xhr.responseJSON.Message) {
                        errorMsg += xhr.responseJSON.Message;
                    } else if (xhr.responseText) {
                        errorMsg += 'Chi tiết: ' + xhr.responseText;
                    } else {
                        errorMsg += 'Vui lòng thử lại sau.';
                    }
                    addMessageToChat('ai', errorMsg);
                }
            });
            return false;
        }

        function addMessageToChat(sender, message, isLoading = false) {
            // Ẩn quick actions container khi bắt đầu chat
            if (sender === 'user') {
                $('.ai-quick-actions-container').hide();
            }

            const messageDiv = $('<div>').addClass(`message ${sender}-message`);
            if (isLoading) messageDiv.addClass('ai-loading');

            if (sender === 'user') {
                messageDiv.html(`
                    <div class="message-content">
                        <i class="fa fa-user"></i>
                        <span>${message}</span>
                    </div>
                `);
            } else {
                const processedMessage = processAIResponse(message);
                messageDiv.html(processedMessage);
            }

            $('#chatMessages').append(messageDiv);
            $('#chatMessages').scrollTop($('#chatMessages')[0].scrollHeight);
        }

        function clearChat() {
            $('#chatMessages').empty();
            // Hiển thị lại quick actions container
            $('.ai-quick-actions-container').show();
        }

        function processAIResponse(message) {
            const sections = splitResponseIntoSections(message);

            let html = '<div class="message-content">';
            html += '<i class="fa fa-robot"></i>';

            if (sections.mainContent) {
                html += '<div class="markdown-content">' + marked.parse(sections.mainContent) + '</div>';
            }

            if (sections.followUpQuestions && sections.followUpQuestions.length > 0) {
                html += '<div class="follow-up-section">';
                html += '<div class="follow-up-title">Câu hỏi tiếp theo:</div>';
                html += '<div class="follow-up-questions">';

                sections.followUpQuestions.forEach((question, index) => {
                    html += `<div class="follow-up-question" onclick="askAI('${question.replace(/'/g, "\\'")}')">`;
                    html += `<strong>${index + 1}.</strong> ${question}`;
                    html += '</div>';
                });

                html += '</div></div>';
            }

            if (sections.references && sections.references.length > 0) {
                html += '<div class="references-section">';
                html += '<div class="references-title">Tài liệu tham khảo:</div>';

                sections.references.forEach((ref, index) => {
                    const url = extractURL(ref);
                    if (url) {
                        html += `<a href="${url}" target="_blank" class="reference-link">`;
                        html += `<i class="fa fa-external-link"></i> ${ref.replace(/\[.*?\]\s*/, '')}`;
                        html += '</a>';
                    } else {
                        html += `<div class="reference-link">${ref}</div>`;
                    }
                });

                html += '</div>';
            }

            html += '</div>';
            return html;
        }

        function splitResponseIntoSections(message) {
            const sections = {
                mainContent: '',
                followUpQuestions: [],
                references: []
            };

            const followUpMatch = message.match(/### Follow-up Questions\s*([\s\S]*?)(?=###|References:|$)/i);
            if (followUpMatch) {
                const followUpText = followUpMatch[1].trim();
                const questions = followUpText.split(/\d+\.\s+/).filter(q => q.trim());
                sections.followUpQuestions = questions.map(q => q.trim()).filter(q => q);
            }

            const referencesMatch = message.match(/References:\s*([\s\S]*?)(?=###|$)/i);
            if (referencesMatch) {
                const referencesText = referencesMatch[1].trim();
                const refs = referencesText.split(/\n/).filter(r => r.trim());
                sections.references = refs.map(r => r.trim()).filter(r => r);
            }

            let mainContent = message;
            if (followUpMatch) {
                mainContent = mainContent.replace(followUpMatch[0], '');
            }
            if (referencesMatch) {
                mainContent = mainContent.replace(referencesMatch[0], '');
            }

            sections.mainContent = mainContent.trim();
            return sections;
        }

        function extractURL(text) {
            const urlMatch = text.match(/https?:\/\/[^\s]+/);
            return urlMatch ? urlMatch[0] : null;
        }

        $('#aiUserInput').keypress(function (e) {
            if (e.which === 13) {
                e.preventDefault();
                sendAIMessage();
            }
        });

        $('#aiUserInput').on('input', function () {
            this.style.height = 'auto';
            this.style.height = Math.min(this.scrollHeight, 66) + 'px';
        });
    </script>

<script>
        let currentSubjectCode = 'PRJ301';
        let chatHistory = [];

        // Cấu hình marked.js
        marked.setOptions({
            breaks: true,
            gfm: true
        });

        function toggleAICoach() {
            const widget = $('#aiCoachWidget');
            const toggleBtn = $('.ai-coach-toggle');
            if (widget.is(':visible')) {
                widget.hide();
                toggleBtn.removeClass('active');
            } else {
                widget.show();
                toggleBtn.addClass('active');
                // Đảm bảo quick actions hiển thị khi mở widget
                $('.ai-quick-actions-container').show();
            }
            return false;
        }

        function askAI(question) {
            sendAIMessage(question);
            return false;
        }

        function sendAIMessage(message = null) {
            const userInput = message || $('#aiUserInput').val();
            if (!userInput.trim()) {
                alert('Vui lòng nhập nội dung trước khi gửi!');
                return false;
            }

            console.log('=== AI Coach Request ===');
            console.log('Subject Code:', currentSubjectCode);
            console.log('User Message:', userInput);
            console.log('Education Level:', 'fptu');

            addMessageToChat('user', userInput);
            $('#aiUserInput').val('');
            addMessageToChat('ai', 'Đang suy nghĩ...', true);

            $.ajax({
                url: '/AICoach/Chat',
                method: 'POST',
                dataType: 'json',
                contentType: 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded; charset=UTF-8',
                data: {
                    subjectCode: currentSubjectCode,
                    userMessage: userInput,
                    educationLevel: 'fptu'
                },
                success: function (response) {
                    console.log('=== AI Coach Response Success ===');
                    console.log('Full Response:', response);

                    $('.ai-loading').remove();

                    if (response && typeof response === 'object') {
                        if (response.Success === true) {
                            if (response.Data && response.Data.aiResponse) {
                                console.log('AI Response:', response.Data.aiResponse);
                                addMessageToChat('ai', response.Data.aiResponse);
                            } else {
                                console.error('AI Response missing data.aiResponse');
                                addMessageToChat('ai', 'Có lỗi xảy ra: Response không có dữ liệu AI');
                            }
                        } else {
                            var errorMsg = response.Message || 'Không xác định được lỗi';
                            console.error('AI Coach Error:', errorMsg);
                            addMessageToChat('ai', 'Có lỗi xảy ra: ' + errorMsg);
                        }
                    } else {
                        console.error('Invalid response format:', response);
                        addMessageToChat('ai', 'Có lỗi xảy ra: Response không đúng định dạng');
                    }
                },
                error: function (xhr, status, error) {
                    console.log('=== AI Coach Response Error ===');
                    console.error('XHR Status:', xhr.status);
                    console.error('Error:', error);

                    $('.ai-loading').remove();
                    var errorMsg = 'Không thể kết nối với AI coach. ';
                    if (xhr.responseJSON && xhr.responseJSON.Message) {
                        errorMsg += xhr.responseJSON.Message;
                    } else if (xhr.responseText) {
                        errorMsg += 'Chi tiết: ' + xhr.responseText;
                    } else {
                        errorMsg += 'Vui lòng thử lại sau.';
                    }
                    addMessageToChat('ai', errorMsg);
                }
            });
            return false;
        }

        function addMessageToChat(sender, message, isLoading = false) {
            // Ẩn quick actions container khi bắt đầu chat
            if (sender === 'user') {
                $('.ai-quick-actions-container').hide();
            }

            const messageDiv = $('<div>').addClass(`message ${sender}-message`);
            if (isLoading) messageDiv.addClass('ai-loading');

            if (sender === 'user') {
                messageDiv.html(`
                    <div class="message-content">
                        <i class="fa fa-user"></i>
                        <span>${message}</span>
                    </div>
                `);
            } else {
                const processedMessage = processAIResponse(message);
                messageDiv.html(processedMessage);
            }

            $('#chatMessages').append(messageDiv);
            $('#chatMessages').scrollTop($('#chatMessages')[0].scrollHeight);
        }

        function clearChat() {
            $('#chatMessages').empty();
            // Hiển thị lại quick actions container
            $('.ai-quick-actions-container').show();
        }

        function processAIResponse(message) {
            const sections = splitResponseIntoSections(message);

            let html = '<div class="message-content">';
            html += '<i class="fa fa-robot"></i>';

            if (sections.mainContent) {
                html += '<div class="markdown-content">' + marked.parse(sections.mainContent) + '</div>';
            }

            if (sections.followUpQuestions && sections.followUpQuestions.length > 0) {
                html += '<div class="follow-up-section">';
                html += '<div class="follow-up-title">Câu hỏi tiếp theo:</div>';
                html += '<div class="follow-up-questions">';

                sections.followUpQuestions.forEach((question, index) => {
                    html += `<div class="follow-up-question" onclick="askAI('${question.replace(/'/g, "\\'")}')">`;
                    html += `<strong>${index + 1}.</strong> ${question}`;
                    html += '</div>';
                });

                html += '</div></div>';
            }

            if (sections.references && sections.references.length > 0) {
                html += '<div class="references-section">';
                html += '<div class="references-title">Tài liệu tham khảo:</div>';

                sections.references.forEach((ref, index) => {
                    const url = extractURL(ref);
                    if (url) {
                        html += `<a href="${url}" target="_blank" class="reference-link">`;
                        html += `<i class="fa fa-external-link"></i> ${ref.replace(/\[.*?\]\s*/, '')}`;
                        html += '</a>';
                    } else {
                        html += `<div class="reference-link">${ref}</div>`;
                    }
                });

                html += '</div>';
            }

            html += '</div>';
            return html;
        }

        function splitResponseIntoSections(message) {
            const sections = {
                mainContent: '',
                followUpQuestions: [],
                references: []
            };

            const followUpMatch = message.match(/### Follow-up Questions\s*([\s\S]*?)(?=###|References:|$)/i);
            if (followUpMatch) {
                const followUpText = followUpMatch[1].trim();
                const questions = followUpText.split(/\d+\.\s+/).filter(q => q.trim());
                sections.followUpQuestions = questions.map(q => q.trim()).filter(q => q);
            }

            const referencesMatch = message.match(/References:\s*([\s\S]*?)(?=###|$)/i);
            if (referencesMatch) {
                const referencesText = referencesMatch[1].trim();
                const refs = referencesText.split(/\n/).filter(r => r.trim());
                sections.references = refs.map(r => r.trim()).filter(r => r);
            }

            let mainContent = message;
            if (followUpMatch) {
                mainContent = mainContent.replace(followUpMatch[0], '');
            }
            if (referencesMatch) {
                mainContent = mainContent.replace(referencesMatch[0], '');
            }

            sections.mainContent = mainContent.trim();
            return sections;
        }

        function extractURL(text) {
            const urlMatch = text.match(/https?:\/\/[^\s]+/);
            return urlMatch ? urlMatch[0] : null;
        }

        $('#aiUserInput').keypress(function (e) {
            if (e.which === 13) {
                e.preventDefault();
                sendAIMessage();
            }
        });

        $('#aiUserInput').on('input', function () {
            this.style.height = 'auto';
            this.style.height = Math.min(this.scrollHeight, 66) + 'px';
        });
    </script>

                    Description:
                </td>
<td class="auto-style6">
<span id="lblDescription">This course is a model-based introduction to RE, providing the conceptual background and terminology on RE, addressing a variety of techniques for  requirements  development including Analysis and Requirements Elicitation; Requirements Evaluation; Requirements Specification and Documentation; Requirements Quality Assurance. To implement these  frameworks, student will be learnt  how to find  appropriate customer representatives, elicit requirements from them, and  document user requirements, business rules, functional requirements, data requirements, and nonfunctional requirements. <br/>The numerous visual models  that will be represented to illustrate the requirements from various perspectives to supplement natural-language text. Other contents recommend the most  effective  requirements approaches for various specific classes of projects: agile projects  developing products of any type, enhancement and replacement projects, projects that incorporate packaged solutions, outsourced projects, business process automation projects, business analytics projects, and embedded and other real-time systems.</span>

<script>
        let currentSubjectCode = 'SWR302';
        let chatHistory = [];

        // Cấu hình marked.js
        marked.setOptions({
            breaks: true,
            gfm: true
        });

        function toggleAICoach() {
            const widget = $('#aiCoachWidget');
            const toggleBtn = $('.ai-coach-toggle');
            if (widget.is(':visible')) {
                widget.hide();
                toggleBtn.removeClass('active');
            } else {
                widget.show();
                toggleBtn.addClass('active');
                // Đảm bảo quick actions hiển thị khi mở widget
                $('.ai-quick-actions-container').show();
            }
            return false;
        }

        function askAI(question) {
            sendAIMessage(question);
            return false;
        }

        function sendAIMessage(message = null) {
            const userInput = message || $('#aiUserInput').val();
            if (!userInput.trim()) {
                alert('Vui lòng nhập nội dung trước khi gửi!');
                return false;
            }

            console.log('=== AI Coach Request ===');
            console.log('Subject Code:', currentSubjectCode);
            console.log('User Message:', userInput);
            console.log('Education Level:', 'fptu');

            addMessageToChat('user', userInput);
            $('#aiUserInput').val('');
            addMessageToChat('ai', 'Đang suy nghĩ...', true);

            $.ajax({
                url: '/AICoach/Chat',
                method: 'POST',
                dataType: 'json',
                contentType: 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded; charset=UTF-8',
                data: {
                    subjectCode: currentSubjectCode,
                    userMessage: userInput,
                    educationLevel: 'fptu'
                },
                success: function (response) {
                    console.log('=== AI Coach Response Success ===');
                    console.log('Full Response:', response);

                    $('.ai-loading').remove();

                    if (response && typeof response === 'object') {
                        if (response.Success === true) {
                            if (response.Data && response.Data.aiResponse) {
                                console.log('AI Response:', response.Data.aiResponse);
                                addMessageToChat('ai', response.Data.aiResponse);
                            } else {
                                console.error('AI Response missing data.aiResponse');
                                addMessageToChat('ai', 'Có lỗi xảy ra: Response không có dữ liệu AI');
                            }
                        } else {
                            var errorMsg = response.Message || 'Không xác định được lỗi';
                            console.error('AI Coach Error:', errorMsg);
                            addMessageToChat('ai', 'Có lỗi xảy ra: ' + errorMsg);
                        }
                    } else {
                        console.error('Invalid response format:', response);
                        addMessageToChat('ai', 'Có lỗi xảy ra: Response không đúng định dạng');
                    }
                },
                error: function (xhr, status, error) {
                    console.log('=== AI Coach Response Error ===');
                    console.error('XHR Status:', xhr.status);
                    console.error('Error:', error);

                    $('.ai-loading').remove();
                    var errorMsg = 'Không thể kết nối với AI coach. ';
                    if (xhr.responseJSON && xhr.responseJSON.Message) {
                        errorMsg += xhr.responseJSON.Message;
                    } else if (xhr.responseText) {
                        errorMsg += 'Chi tiết: ' + xhr.responseText;
                    } else {
                        errorMsg += 'Vui lòng thử lại sau.';
                    }
                    addMessageToChat('ai', errorMsg);
                }
            });
            return false;
        }

        function addMessageToChat(sender, message, isLoading = false) {
            // Ẩn quick actions container khi bắt đầu chat
            if (sender === 'user') {
                $('.ai-quick-actions-container').hide();
            }

            const messageDiv = $('<div>').addClass(`message ${sender}-message`);
            if (isLoading) messageDiv.addClass('ai-loading');

            if (sender === 'user') {
                messageDiv.html(`
                    <div class="message-content">
                        <i class="fa fa-user"></i>
                        <span>${message}</span>
                    </div>
                `);
            } else {
                const processedMessage = processAIResponse(message);
                messageDiv.html(processedMessage);
            }

            $('#chatMessages').append(messageDiv);
            $('#chatMessages').scrollTop($('#chatMessages')[0].scrollHeight);
        }

        function clearChat() {
            $('#chatMessages').empty();
            // Hiển thị lại quick actions container
            $('.ai-quick-actions-container').show();
        }

        function processAIResponse(message) {
            const sections = splitResponseIntoSections(message);

            let html = '<div class="message-content">';
            html += '<i class="fa fa-robot"></i>';

            if (sections.mainContent) {
                html += '<div class="markdown-content">' + marked.parse(sections.mainContent) + '</div>';
            }

            if (sections.followUpQuestions && sections.followUpQuestions.length > 0) {
                html += '<div class="follow-up-section">';
                html += '<div class="follow-up-title">Câu hỏi tiếp theo:</div>';
                html += '<div class="follow-up-questions">';

                sections.followUpQuestions.forEach((question, index) => {
                    html += `<div class="follow-up-question" onclick="askAI('${question.replace(/'/g, "\\'")}')">`;
                    html += `<strong>${index + 1}.</strong> ${question}`;
                    html += '</div>';
                });

                html += '</div></div>';
            }

            if (sections.references && sections.references.length > 0) {
                html += '<div class="references-section">';
                html += '<div class="references-title">Tài liệu tham khảo:</div>';

                sections.references.forEach((ref, index) => {
                    const url = extractURL(ref);
                    if (url) {
                        html += `<a href="${url}" target="_blank" class="reference-link">`;
                        html += `<i class="fa fa-external-link"></i> ${ref.replace(/\[.*?\]\s*/, '')}`;
                        html += '</a>';
                    } else {
                        html += `<div class="reference-link">${ref}</div>`;
                    }
                });

                html += '</div>';
            }

            html += '</div>';
            return html;
        }

        function splitResponseIntoSections(message) {
            const sections = {
                mainContent: '',
                followUpQuestions: [],
                references: []
            };

            const followUpMatch = message.match(/### Follow-up Questions\s*([\s\S]*?)(?=###|References:|$)/i);
            if (followUpMatch) {
                const followUpText = followUpMatch[1].trim();
                const questions = followUpText.split(/\d+\.\s+/).filter(q => q.trim());
                sections.followUpQuestions = questions.map(q => q.trim()).filter(q => q);
            }

            const referencesMatch = message.match(/References:\s*([\s\S]*?)(?=###|$)/i);
            if (referencesMatch) {
                const referencesText = referencesMatch[1].trim();
                const refs = referencesText.split(/\n/).filter(r => r.trim());
                sections.references = refs.map(r => r.trim()).filter(r => r);
            }

            let mainContent = message;
            if (followUpMatch) {
                mainContent = mainContent.replace(followUpMatch[0], '');
            }
            if (referencesMatch) {
                mainContent = mainContent.replace(referencesMatch[0], '');
            }

            sections.mainContent = mainContent.trim();
            return sections;
        }

        function extractURL(text) {
            const urlMatch = text.match(/https?:\/\/[^\s]+/);
            return urlMatch ? urlMatch[0] : null;
        }

        $('#aiUserInput').keypress(function (e) {
            if (e.which === 13) {
                e.preventDefault();
                sendAIMessage();
            }
        });

        $('#aiUserInput').on('input', function () {
            this.style.height = 'auto';
            this.style.height = Math.min(this.scrollHeight, 66) + 'px';
        });
    </script>

<script>
        let currentSubjectCode = 'SWP391';
        let chatHistory = [];

        // Cấu hình marked.js
        marked.setOptions({
            breaks: true,
            gfm: true
        });

        function toggleAICoach() {
            const widget = $('#aiCoachWidget');
            const toggleBtn = $('.ai-coach-toggle');
            if (widget.is(':visible')) {
                widget.hide();
                toggleBtn.removeClass('active');
            } else {
                widget.show();
                toggleBtn.addClass('active');
                // Đảm bảo quick actions hiển thị khi mở widget
                $('.ai-quick-actions-container').show();
            }
            return false;
        }

        function askAI(question) {
            sendAIMessage(question);
            return false;
        }

        function sendAIMessage(message = null) {
            const userInput = message || $('#aiUserInput').val();
            if (!userInput.trim()) {
                alert('Vui lòng nhập nội dung trước khi gửi!');
                return false;
            }

            console.log('=== AI Coach Request ===');
            console.log('Subject Code:', currentSubjectCode);
            console.log('User Message:', userInput);
            console.log('Education Level:', 'fptu');

            addMessageToChat('user', userInput);
            $('#aiUserInput').val('');
            addMessageToChat('ai', 'Đang suy nghĩ...', true);

            $.ajax({
                url: '/AICoach/Chat',
                method: 'POST',
                dataType: 'json',
                contentType: 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded; charset=UTF-8',
                data: {
                    subjectCode: currentSubjectCode,
                    userMessage: userInput,
                    educationLevel: 'fptu'
                },
                success: function (response) {
                    console.log('=== AI Coach Response Success ===');
                    console.log('Full Response:', response);

                    $('.ai-loading').remove();

                    if (response && typeof response === 'object') {
                        if (response.Success === true) {
                            if (response.Data && response.Data.aiResponse) {
                                console.log('AI Response:', response.Data.aiResponse);
                                addMessageToChat('ai', response.Data.aiResponse);
                            } else {
                                console.error('AI Response missing data.aiResponse');
                                addMessageToChat('ai', 'Có lỗi xảy ra: Response không có dữ liệu AI');
                            }
                        } else {
                            var errorMsg = response.Message || 'Không xác định được lỗi';
                            console.error('AI Coach Error:', errorMsg);
                            addMessageToChat('ai', 'Có lỗi xảy ra: ' + errorMsg);
                        }
                    } else {
                        console.error('Invalid response format:', response);
                        addMessageToChat('ai', 'Có lỗi xảy ra: Response không đúng định dạng');
                    }
                },
                error: function (xhr, status, error) {
                    console.log('=== AI Coach Response Error ===');
                    console.error('XHR Status:', xhr.status);
                    console.error('Error:', error);

                    $('.ai-loading').remove();
                    var errorMsg = 'Không thể kết nối với AI coach. ';
                    if (xhr.responseJSON && xhr.responseJSON.Message) {
                        errorMsg += xhr.responseJSON.Message;
                    } else if (xhr.responseText) {
                        errorMsg += 'Chi tiết: ' + xhr.responseText;
                    } else {
                        errorMsg += 'Vui lòng thử lại sau.';
                    }
                    addMessageToChat('ai', errorMsg);
                }
            });
            return false;
        }

        function addMessageToChat(sender, message, isLoading = false) {
            // Ẩn quick actions container khi bắt đầu chat
            if (sender === 'user') {
                $('.ai-quick-actions-container').hide();
            }

            const messageDiv = $('<div>').addClass(`message ${sender}-message`);
            if (isLoading) messageDiv.addClass('ai-loading');

            if (sender === 'user') {
                messageDiv.html(`
                    <div class="message-content">
                        <i class="fa fa-user"></i>
                        <span>${message}</span>
                    </div>
                `);
            } else {
                const processedMessage = processAIResponse(message);
                messageDiv.html(processedMessage);
            }

            $('#chatMessages').append(messageDiv);
            $('#chatMessages').scrollTop($('#chatMessages')[0].scrollHeight);
        }

        function clearChat() {
            $('#chatMessages').empty();
            // Hiển thị lại quick actions container
            $('.ai-quick-actions-container').show();
        }

        function processAIResponse(message) {
            const sections = splitResponseIntoSections(message);

            let html = '<div class="message-content">';
            html += '<i class="fa fa-robot"></i>';

            if (sections.mainContent) {
                html += '<div class="markdown-content">' + marked.parse(sections.mainContent) + '</div>';
            }

            if (sections.followUpQuestions && sections.followUpQuestions.length > 0) {
                html += '<div class="follow-up-section">';
                html += '<div class="follow-up-title">Câu hỏi tiếp theo:</div>';
                html += '<div class="follow-up-questions">';

                sections.followUpQuestions.forEach((question, index) => {
                    html += `<div class="follow-up-question" onclick="askAI('${question.replace(/'/g, "\\'")}')">`;
                    html += `<strong>${index + 1}.</strong> ${question}`;
                    html += '</div>';
                });

                html += '</div></div>';
            }

            if (sections.references && sections.references.length > 0) {
                html += '<div class="references-section">';
                html += '<div class="references-title">Tài liệu tham khảo:</div>';

                sections.references.forEach((ref, index) => {
                    const url = extractURL(ref);
                    if (url) {
                        html += `<a href="${url}" target="_blank" class="reference-link">`;
                        html += `<i class="fa fa-external-link"></i> ${ref.replace(/\[.*?\]\s*/, '')}`;
                        html += '</a>';
                    } else {
                        html += `<div class="reference-link">${ref}</div>`;
                    }
                });

                html += '</div>';
            }

            html += '</div>';
            return html;
        }

        function splitResponseIntoSections(message) {
            const sections = {
                mainContent: '',
                followUpQuestions: [],
                references: []
            };

            const followUpMatch = message.match(/### Follow-up Questions\s*([\s\S]*?)(?=###|References:|$)/i);
            if (followUpMatch) {
                const followUpText = followUpMatch[1].trim();
                const questions = followUpText.split(/\d+\.\s+/).filter(q => q.trim());
                sections.followUpQuestions = questions.map(q => q.trim()).filter(q => q);
            }

            const referencesMatch = message.match(/References:\s*([\s\S]*?)(?=###|$)/i);
            if (referencesMatch) {
                const referencesText = referencesMatch[1].trim();
                const refs = referencesText.split(/\n/).filter(r => r.trim());
                sections.references = refs.map(r => r.trim()).filter(r => r);
            }

            let mainContent = message;
            if (followUpMatch) {
                mainContent = mainContent.replace(followUpMatch[0], '');
            }
            if (referencesMatch) {
                mainContent = mainContent.replace(referencesMatch[0], '');
            }

                height: 20px;

            }

        @keyframes spin {
            to {
                transform: rotate(360deg);
            }
